court.sentenceEn: It is too easy, and misleading, to see such court rulings as merely standing up for the rights of land owners when the consequences can be so dire for their neighbors.
court.translationZh: 如果只将此类法院裁决视为维护土地所有者的权利，而忽视其可能给周边社区带来的严重后果，这种看法不仅过于简单，而且具有误导性。
court.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

court.sentenceEn: All this was put at great risk late last month, when the U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling in an Idaho case that provides the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) far less authority to regulate wetlands and waterways.
court.translationZh: 然而，所有这一切在上个月末陷入了巨大的危机——美国最高法院就爱达荷州的一起案件作出裁决，大幅削弱了美国环境保护局(EPA)对湿地和水道的监管权。
court.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

court.sentenceEn: But Judge Patricia Millett rightly argued in a concurring opinion that "the result is unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service," and said Congress or the Supreme Court could intervene to "avoid trapping Internet regulation in technological anachronism."
court.translationZh: 但帕特里夏·米利特法官在其协同意见中正确指出，"这一结果脱离了现代宽带服务的实际情况"，并表示国会或最高法院可进行干预，以"避免将互联网监管困在技术时代错误之中"。
court.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

court.sentenceEn: In the meantime, the court threw out the FCC's attempt to block all state rules on net neutrality, while preserving the commission's power to preempt individual state laws that undermine its order.
court.translationZh: 与此同时，法院驳回了联邦通信委员会试图阻止所有州级网络中立性规则的尝试，但保留了该委员会优先否决那些有损其命令的个别州法律的权力。
court.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

court.sentenceEn: Who are most likely to welcome the Supreme Court ruling?
court.translationZh: 谁最有可能欢迎最高法院的这项裁决？

court.sentenceEn: It is welcomed by the Supreme Court .
court.translationZh: 最高法院对此表示欢迎。

customer.sentenceEn: Standing in the shoes of others fine tunes our social understanding, useful as we struggle to understand friends, neighbours, customers and co-workers.
customer.translationZh: 设身处地为他人着想能让我们微调自己的社交理解力，这在我们努力理解朋友、邻居、客户和同事时非常有用。

customer.sentenceEn: The prevalence of digital payment devices has made it easier to ask customers for a tip.
customer.translationZh: 数字支付设备的普及使得向顾客索要小费变得更加容易。
customer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

customer.sentenceEn: These systems often prompted customers to tip for services that were not previously tipped.
customer.translationZh: 这些系统常常会提示顾客为以前不需要给小费的服务支付小费。
customer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

customer.sentenceEn: Customers now routinely see menus of suggested default options—often well above 20% of what they owe.
customer.translationZh: 顾客现在经常会看到建议的默认选项菜单——通常远高于账单金额的20%。
customer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

customer.sentenceEn: However, many customers are frustrated because they feel they are being asked for too high of a tip, too often.
customer.translationZh: 然而，许多顾客感到不满，因为他们觉得被索要的小费过高、过于频繁。
customer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

case.sentenceEn: Similarly, in the case of your friends cancelling, perhaps they both felt unwell that weekend or they just changed their minds.
case.translationZh: 同样，关于你的朋友取消邀约这件事，也许他们那个周末都感到身体不适，或者只是改变了主意。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

case.sentenceEn: In many cases , it is the best option — in terms of travel time and cost — for both leisure and business travellers.
case.translationZh: 在许多情况下，无论是对于休闲游客还是商务旅行者，这在旅行时间和成本方面都是最佳选择。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

case.sentenceEn: It can be hard for scientists to make the case because our work is complex, often takes place behind closed doors and does not always lend itself to easy interpretation or explanation.
case.translationZh: 科学家们往往难以阐明自己的工作价值，因为我们的研究复杂难懂，常常在闭门情况下进行，而且并非总能轻易解释或说明。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

case.sentenceEn: In many cases the experts have a hard time agreeing on what is the real object and what is a forgery.
case.translationZh: 在许多情况下，专家们也很难确定哪些是真品，哪些是赝品。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

case.sentenceEn: All this was put at great risk late last month, when the U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling in an Idaho case that provides the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) far less authority to regulate wetlands and waterways.
case.translationZh: 然而，所有这一切在上个月末陷入了巨大的危机——美国最高法院就爱达荷州的一起案件作出裁决，大幅削弱了美国环境保护局(EPA)对湿地和水道的监管权。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

case.sentenceEn: She is proud that several sculptures have even gone on display again, albeit sometimes beneath protective cases .
case.translationZh: 她感到自豪的是，有几件雕塑甚至再次展出，尽管有时需要置于保护罩之下。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

consumer.sentenceEn: Without additional protections in place, companies may share (and potentially monetize) personal health information in a way consumers may not have authorized or anticipated.
consumer.translationZh: 如果缺乏额外保护措施，企业可能会以消费者未授权或未预料的方式分享（并可能通过商业化手段利用）个人健康信息。
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

consumer.sentenceEn: California has been at the forefront of state privacy efforts with the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018.
consumer.translationZh: 加利福尼亚州凭借2018年出台的《加州消费者隐私法》，在州级隐私保护工作中一直走在前列。
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

consumer.sentenceEn: Section 5 of the FTC Act empowers the FTC to initiate enforcement action against unfair or deceptive acts, meaning the FTC can only act after the fact if a company's privacy practices are misleading or cause unjustified consumer harm.
consumer.translationZh: 《联邦贸易委员会法案》第5条授权联邦贸易委员会对不公平或欺骗性行为采取执法行动，这意味着只有当某公司的隐私做法具有误导性或对消费者造成不正当损害时，联邦贸易委员会才能在事后采取行动。
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

consumer.sentenceEn: While the FTC is doing what it can to ensure apps are keeping their promises to consumers around the handling of their sensitive health information, the rate at which these health apps are hitting the market demonstrates just how immense of a challenge this is.
consumer.translationZh: 尽管联邦贸易委员会正尽其所能确保应用程序履行对消费者在敏感健康信息处理方面的承诺，但这些健康应用程序涌入市场的速度表明，这是一项多么艰巨的挑战。
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

consumer.sentenceEn: Virginia, Colorado and Utah have also recently passed state consumer data privacy legislation.
consumer.translationZh: 弗吉尼亚州、科罗拉多州和犹他州最近也通过了本州的消费者数据隐私法规。
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

consumer.sentenceEn: "All this comes at an increased cost during a time when prices are already sky high. Inevitably, consumers will have to pay more," he says.
consumer.translationZh: 他表示：“所有这些都将增加成本，而眼下各种价格已经高得离谱。消费者将不可避免地要支付更多费用。”
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

community.sentenceEn: This concept has served as a central goal for curriculum developers, local school boards, business and community leaders, and policymakers ever since its introduction nearly 80 years ago.
community.translationZh: 自近80年前被提出以来，这一概念一直是课程开发者、地方学校委员会、商业与社区领袖以及决策者们的中心目标。
community.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

community.sentenceEn: But for the most part, this isn't what the business community does.
community.translationZh: 但在大多数情况下，商界并不是这么做的。

community.sentenceEn: This summer, as you enjoy your favorite neighborhood street festival, I hope you'll remember that they exist because of community support.
community.translationZh: 今年夏天，当您尽情享受家门口的街道节庆时，希望您能记住，正是有了社区的支持，这些活动才得以存在。
community.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

community.sentenceEn: The Silver Room Block Party, staged by Hyde Park community leader Eric Williams, announced it would not return in 2024.
community.translationZh: 由海德公园社区领袖埃里克·威廉姆斯（Eric Williams）发起的银色房间街头派对（Silver Room Block Party）宣布，该活动将不会在2024年回归。
community.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

community.sentenceEn: Wicker Park Fest has long been one of Chicago's most anticipated summer festivals, drawing upward of 70,000 attendees for a full weekend of live indie music, local art, small business vendors and, most importantly, community connection.
community.translationZh: 柳克尔公园庆典（Wicker Park Fest）长期以来一直是芝加哥最受期待的夏季节庆活动之一，在整个周末期间，它吸引了超过 7 万名参与者，共同享受现场独立音乐、当地艺术、小店摊位，以及最重要的——社区联结。
community.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

community.sentenceEn: Students whose extracurricular activity has benefited their community are likely to win a scholarship.
community.translationZh: 通过课外活动为社区带来益处的学生有可能获得奖学金。

concern.sentenceEn: While AI offers exciting possibilities, it also raises ethical concerns .
concern.translationZh: 人工智能在带来令人兴奋的可能性的同时，也引发了伦理方面的担忧。
concern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

concern.sentenceEn: "We know enough to know that this is a concern , but we don't know enough about how to respond to it yet. That's a great area to be doing research."
concern.translationZh: 我们已经了解到这确实是个问题，但对于如何应对，目前掌握的信息还不够充分。这正是开展研究的绝佳领域。
concern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

concern.sentenceEn: Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming, with the likes of Disney+, Peacock and Paramount+ losing billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that the services will never be as profitable as cable once was.
concern.translationZh: 自从开始与网飞公司(Netflix Inc.)在其主场展开竞争以来，传统好莱坞在流媒体业务上一直难以实现盈利。迪士尼+、孔雀(Peacock)和派拉蒙+等平台每年亏损数十亿美元，这引发了人们的担忧：这些流媒体服务可能永远无法像有线电视曾经那样盈利。
concern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

concern.sentenceEn: You might have concerns about losing control of whatever it is you're asking for help with.
concern.translationZh: 你可能会担心自己正在寻求帮助的事情会失去控制。
concern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

concern.sentenceEn: Instead, listen to their concerns fully, try to understand their perspective, and include their concerns (and possible remedies) in future discussions.
concern.translationZh: 相反，要充分倾听他们的顾虑，努力理解他们的观点，并在未来的讨论中纳入他们的担忧（以及可能的解决办法）。
concern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

concern.sentenceEn: Concern over security is no excuse for refusing to return artifacts to their countries of origin.
concern.translationZh: 以安全为借口拒绝将文物归还给其原产国是站不住脚的。

challenge.sentenceEn: And this is where the challenge lies.
challenge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

challenge.sentenceEn: One simple way to avoid engaging in personalisation and mind reading is to challenge your negative assumptions of what's happened.
challenge.translationZh: 避免陷入‘个人化’和‘读心术’误区的一个简单方法，就是去质疑你对已发生事情的负面假设。
challenge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

challenge.sentenceEn: But by utilising the natural curiosity of the general public it is possible to overcome many of these challenges by engaging non-scientists directly in the research process.
challenge.translationZh: 但通过利用公众的天然好奇心，可以让非科研人员直接参与研究过程，从而克服其中许多挑战。
challenge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

challenge.sentenceEn: But demonstrating the efficacy of science will be crucial if we are to solve humanity's greatest challenges .
challenge.translationZh: 然而，若要解决人类面临的最大挑战，证明科学的有效性将至关重要。
challenge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

challenge.sentenceEn: What challenge is the FTC currently faced with?
challenge.translationZh: 联邦贸易委员会（FTC）目前面临什么挑战？

challenge.sentenceEn: Keeping digital historical records is a challenge .
challenge.translationZh: 保存数字化历史记录是一项挑战。

climate.sentenceEn: Yet even as scientists and public officials increasingly agree on the need for more fires in our forests, climate change is making this tactic more challenging, experts said.
climate.translationZh: 专家表示，尽管科学家和公职人员日益达成共识，认为我们的森林需要更多计划性火烧，但气候变化正使这一策略面临更大的挑战。
climate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

climate.sentenceEn: Not only does understanding the equines' genetic makeup help reveal their contribution to human history, but it also might improve their management in the future, as climate change alters the planet's environment, write the authors.
climate.translationZh: 作者写道，了解马科动物的基因构成不仅有助于揭示它们对人类历史的贡献，而且随着气候变化改变地球环境，这还可能改善未来对它们的管理。
climate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

climate.sentenceEn: "It's a double-edged sword because wildfires are getting more severe and larger under climate change and we need this work even more, but then the work gets more challenging," said Susan Prichard, a fire ecologist at the University of Washington.
climate.translationZh: 华盛顿大学的火灾生态学家苏珊·普里查德表示：“这是一把双刃剑，因为在气候变化的影响下，野火正变得愈发严重且规模更大，我们比以往任何时候都更需要这项工作，但与此同时，工作的开展也变得更具挑战性。”
climate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

climate.sentenceEn: "Yet the combined consequences of suppression and climate change have eroded humanity's ability to suppress fires, particularly those that ignite under the most dangerous weather conditions."
climate.translationZh: 然而，森林防火抑制与气候变化的双重影响，削弱了人类扑灭山火的能力，尤其是那些在极端恶劣天气条件下诱发的火灾。
climate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

climate.sentenceEn: "But if you ask a farmer in Brazil if he or she is concerned about climate change, they would say, 'No, I am concerned about water,'" he says.
climate.translationZh: 他说：“但如果你问巴西的农民是否担心气候变化，他们会说，‘不，我担心的是水。’”
climate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

climate.sentenceEn: stress the consequences of climate change.

claim.sentenceEn: The FTC alleged in a complaint that "despite express privacy claims , the company took control of users' sensitive fertility data and shared it with third parties."
claim.translationZh: 联邦贸易委员会在起诉书中指控，“尽管该公司明确做出了隐私承诺，但仍控制了用户的敏感生育数据并将其分享给第三方。”
claim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

claim.sentenceEn: "There are as many scientists working against all the panic of global climate change as there are those who are pushing it," she claims .
claim.translationZh: 她声称：“有多少科学家在推动全球气候变化恐慌，就有多少科学家在反对这种恐慌。”
claim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

claim.sentenceEn: A Twitter account, which claims to "cut through the greenwash" of artificial grass, already has more than 20,000 followers.
claim.translationZh: 一个声称要"揭穿人造草坪绿色伪装"的推特账号已有超过2万名关注者。
claim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

claim.sentenceEn: The industry also claims that people who lay fake grass spend an average of £500 on trees or shrubs for their garden, which provides habitat for insects.
claim.translationZh: 人造草坪行业还声称，铺设人造草坪的人平均会花费500英镑为自家花园购买树木或灌木，这为昆虫提供了栖息地。
claim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

claim.sentenceEn: "They even claimed that plants have 'brain-like command centers' at their root tips."
claim.translationZh: 他们甚至声称植物的根尖处存在'类似大脑的指挥中心'。
claim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

claim.sentenceEn: Both the wildlife park and zoo claimed to be operating for the benefit of the animals and for conservation purposes.
claim.translationZh: 野生动物园和动物园都声称其运营是为了动物的利益和保护目的。
claim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

career.sentenceEn: Board members like her "casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists as just another misguided opinion," says Dan Quinn, senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network, a non-profit group that monitors public education.
career.translationZh: 得克萨斯自由网络（一个监督公共教育的非营利组织）的高级传播策略师丹·奎因表示，像她这样的委员会成员"随意地将学者和科学家的毕生事业贬低为又一个错误的观点"。
career.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

career.sentenceEn: The careers of scientists and the reputation of their institutions depend on the number and prestige of the papers they produce, but even more so on the citations attracted by these papers.
career.translationZh: 科学家的职业生涯及其所在机构的声誉取决于他们发表论文的数量和声望，但更重要的是这些论文所获得的引用量。
career.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

career.sentenceEn: It has been estimated that this generation, due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfilment and desire for diversity, will work for 17 different employers over the course of their working life and have five different careers .
career.translationZh: 据估计，由于技术发展的压力、对个人成就感的追求以及对多元化的渴望，这一代人在其职业生涯中将为17个不同的雇主工作，并从事5种不同的职业。
career.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

career.sentenceEn: Education, and not just knowledge gained on campus, will be a core part of Generation Z's career trajectory.
career.translationZh: 教育，不仅仅是在校园里获得的知识，将成为Z世代职业发展轨迹的核心部分。
career.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

career.sentenceEn: It is unlikely that Generation Z will be done with education at 18 or 21; they will need to be constantly upskilling throughout their career to stay employable.
career.translationZh: Z世代不太可能在18岁或21岁就结束学业；他们需要在整个职业生涯中不断提升技能，以保持就业能力。
career.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

career.sentenceEn: In a 2019 survey of University of Georgia students, meanwhile, the career office found the most desirable trait in a future employer was the ability to offer secure employment (followed by professional development and training, and then inspiring purpose).
career.translationZh: 与此同时，乔治亚大学就业指导办公室在2019年对本校学生的一项调查中发现，未来雇主最令人向往的特质是能够提供稳定的工作（其次是专业发展和培训，然后是鼓舞人心的目标）。
career.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

current.sentenceEn: These agencies and other government bodies should dramatically improve incentives to keep our current shows and attract new productions to Los Angeles.
current.translationZh: 这些机构和其他政府部门应当大幅加大激励力度，以留住现有的影视节目并吸引新作品来到洛杉矶。
current.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

current.sentenceEn: In recent decades, shifting currents and climate change have eroded a natural barrier that protected Pavlopetri.
current.translationZh: 近几十年来，洋流变化和气候变化侵蚀了曾经保护帕夫洛佩特里的自然屏障。
current.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

current.sentenceEn: Yet researchers can take some comfort in the fact that there are a multitude of librarians devoted to discovering, organizing, and preserving digital information for researchers current and future.
current.translationZh: 然而，研究人员可以稍感慰藉的是，有众多图书管理员致力于为当下及未来的研究人员发现、整理和保存数字信息。
current.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

current.sentenceEn: So, instead of saying, "Martha, our current slogan is confusing and should be updated," you could try, "Martha raises a great point that our current slogan has a long history for our stakeholders, but I wonder if we might be able to brainstorm a tagline that could build on that—and be clearer for new customers."
current.translationZh: 所以，与其说“玛莎，我们现在的口号让人困惑，应该更新了”，你可以试试这样说：“玛莎提出了一个很好的观点，我们现在的口号对利益相关者来说有着悠久的历史，但我在想，我们是否可以集思广益，在这个基础上创造一个对新客户来说更清晰的宣传语。”
current.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

creative.translationZh: 事实上，创造性解决问题的能力在日常生活中极为有用，有了这种能力，当问题出现时，你更有可能找到解决方案。
creative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

creative.sentenceEn: However, during that course I realized I was not good enough in this area to compete with other creative personalities in the future, so I decided that it was not the right path for me.
creative.translationZh: 然而，在那门课程学习期间，我意识到自己在这个领域的才华不足以在未来与其他富有创造力的人才竞争，因此我断定这并非我的正确道路。
creative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

creative.sentenceEn: Applications like tumblr.com, which allow users to combine pictures, words and other media in creative ways and then share them, have the potential to add stickiness by amusing, entertaining and enlightening others.
creative.translationZh: 像tumblr.com这样的应用，允许用户以富有创意的方式将图片、文字和其他媒体内容组合在一起然后分享，它们有潜力通过娱乐、消遣和启发他人来增加这种“黏性”。

citizen.sentenceEn: You don't even need any formal training, just an inquisitive mind and the enthusiasm to join one of the thousands of citizen science projects to generate new knowledge and the means to understand a genuine scientific outcome.
citizen.translationZh: 你甚至不需要任何正式培训，只需要一颗好奇的心和参与数千个公民科学项目的热情，就能为新知识的产生贡献力量，并理解真正的科学成果。
citizen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

citizen.sentenceEn: These groups of people are part of a rapidly expanding biotechnological social movement of citizen scientists and professional scientists seeking to take discovery out of institutions and put it into the hands of anyone with the enthusiasm.
citizen.translationZh: 这些人群是一个迅速发展的生物技术社会运动的组成部分，该运动由公民科学家和专业科学家共同发起，旨在将科学发现从科研机构中解放出来，交到每一个充满热情的人手中。
citizen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

citizen.sentenceEn: Citizen science provides an opportunity for greater public engagement and the democratisation of science.
citizen.translationZh: 公民科学为公众更广泛参与和科学民主化提供了机会。
citizen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

citizen.sentenceEn: Anyone can be a citizen scientist, regardless of age, nationality or academic experience.
citizen.translationZh: 无论年龄、国籍或学术经历如何，任何人都可以成为公民科学家。
citizen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

citizen.sentenceEn: They've implored citizen scientists to help with bug counting and categorising cancer cells, and even identifying distant galaxies.
citizen.translationZh: 他们恳请公民科学家协助进行昆虫计数、癌细胞分类，甚至识别遥远的星系。
citizen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

citizen.sentenceEn: A citizen science-based approach can extend the field of vision and include more ideas and different brains to problem-solve and create, making innovation faster and more effective.
citizen.translationZh: 基于公民科学的方法能够拓展视野，汇集更多创意和多元智慧来解决问题与创新，从而使创新过程更快、更有效。
citizen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

conflict.sentenceEn: Stand in the shoes of scientists and witness the degree to which breakthroughs emerge from accidents, conflict and sheer mental stamina.
conflict.translationZh: 身临其境地体验科学家的生活，见证重大突破是如何在偶然、冲突以及非凡的意志力中诞生的。

conflict.sentenceEn: That conflicted with how I needed to train to reach my goals.
conflict.translationZh: 这与我为实现目标所需要的训练方式相冲突。
conflict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

conflict.sentenceEn: Mental health is the source of creativity for solving problems, resolving conflict , making our surroundings more beautiful, managing our home life, or coming up with a creative business idea or invention to make our lives easier.
conflict.translationZh: 心理健康是解决问题、化解冲突、美化环境、经营家庭生活的创造力源泉，也是提出创意商业构想或发明来简化我们生活的灵感所在。
conflict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

conflict.sentenceEn: The White House argued that Arizona's laws conflicted with its enforcement priorities, even if state laws complied with federal statutes to the letter.
conflict.translationZh: 白宫辩称，即便亚利桑那州的法律在条文上完全符合联邦法规，这些州法也与其执法优先事项相冲突。
conflict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

conflict.sentenceEn: Two of the three objecting Justices – Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas – agreed with this Constitutional logic but disagreed about which Arizona rules conflicted with the federal statute.
conflict.translationZh: 在三位持反对意见的大法官中，塞缪尔·阿利托和克拉伦斯·托马斯两位同意这一宪法逻辑，但在亚利桑那州哪些法规与联邦法律存在冲突的问题上持有不同意见。
conflict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

conflict.sentenceEn: It caused conflicts among tech giants.
conflict.translationZh: 这导致了科技巨头之间的冲突。

corporation.sentenceEn: According to a study by Catalyst, between 2010 and 2015 the share of women on the boards of global corporations increased by 54 percent.
corporation.translationZh: 根据Catalyst的一项研究，2010年至2015年间，全球企业董事会中的女性占比增长了54%。
corporation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

corporation.sentenceEn: It is true that CEO pay has gone up—top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers on average, and since the mid-1970s, CEO pay for large publicly traded American corporations has, by varying estimates, gone up by about 500%.
corporation.translationZh: 确实，首席执行官的薪酬有所上涨——顶级CEO的薪酬平均可能是普通员工的300倍，而且自20世纪70年代中期以来，据各种不同估计，美国大型上市公司首席执行官的薪酬上涨了约500%。
corporation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

corporation.sentenceEn: The typical CEO of a top American corporation now makes about $18.9 million a year.
corporation.translationZh: 如今，美国顶级企业首席执行官的年薪约为1890万美元。
corporation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

corporation.sentenceEn: Yet officials also hope for a much larger benefit: more long-term decision-making, not only by banks but by all corporations , to build a stronger economy for future generations.
corporation.translationZh: 然而，官员们还期望获得一个更大的益处：不仅银行，而是所有企业都能做出更具长远考量的决策，为子孙后代构建更强劲的经济。
corporation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

corporation.sentenceEn: After all, four decades of evidence has now shown that corporations in Europe as well as the US are evading the meritocratic hiring and promotion of women to top positions – no matter how much "soft pressure" is put upon them.
corporation.translationZh: 毕竟，四十年的证据现已表明，无论受到多少“软压力”，欧洲和美国的企业都在回避以任人唯贤的方式招聘女性并将其提拔到高层职位。
corporation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

corporation.sentenceEn: Reding invited corporations to sign up for gender balance goals of 40 per cent female board membership.
corporation.translationZh: 雷丁呼吁各企业签署承诺书，致力于实现女性在董事会成员中占40%的性别平衡目标。
corporation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

collection.sentenceEn: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
collection.translationZh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
collection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

collection.sentenceEn: As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets, I share the night terrors of historians, and I'd be lying if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists.
collection.translationZh: 作为一名日常工作围绕特藏文献和数字资产展开的图书馆员，我与历史学家们有着同样的梦魇。如果说目前存在一个全面的保存解决方案，那我一定是在撒谎。
collection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

collection.sentenceEn: What was more, many original French dispatches had been preserved in this collection , which I realized was priceless.
collection.translationZh: 更重要的是，这组档案中还保存了许多法国原始公文，我意识到这可是无价之宝。
collection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

collection.sentenceEn: Of course, I need to concede that my collection of 'Smiling Victorians' makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture created between 1840 and 1900, the majority of which show sitters posing miserably and stiffly in front of painted backdrops, or staring absently into the middle distance.
collection.translationZh: 当然，我必须承认，我收集的这些'微笑的维多利亚人'照片，只占1840至1900年间浩如烟海的人像摄影作品中的极小一部分。绝大多数照片中的人物都在彩绘背景前摆着痛苦而僵硬的姿势，或是茫然地凝视着远方。
collection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

collection.sentenceEn: Derek Jarman's yellow-tinted film Towards Avebury, a collection of long, mostly still shots of the Wiltshire landscape, evokes a tradition of English landscape painting stretching from Samuel Palmer to Paul Nash.
collection.translationZh: 德里克·贾曼的泛黄影片《走向埃夫伯里》由一系列威尔特郡 landscape 的长镜头（大多为静止画面）组成，它唤起了一段从塞缪尔·帕尔默延伸至保罗·纳什的英国 landscape 绘画传统。
collection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

collection.sentenceEn: Supporters of the theory viewed culture as a collection of integrated parts that work together to keep a society functioning.
collection.translationZh: 该理论的支持者将文化视为相互整合的各个部分的集合，这些部分共同作用以维持社会的正常运转。
collection.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）

comment.sentenceEn: Any comments or experiences that undermine those feelings of self-worth can be uncomfortable and it's only natural to want to avoid them.
comment.translationZh: 任何贬低自我价值感的言论或经历都会让人感到不适，而想要逃避这些自然是人之常情。
comment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

comment.sentenceEn: To those of you in the comments section who are having strong feelings about artifacts being removed from cities in the U.S. and Britain and returned to their countries of origin, I would ask you to consider why do you think Americans have more of a right to easily access the Benin Bronzes than the people of Nigeria?
comment.translationZh: 对于评论区中那些对从美国和英国城市移走文物并将其归还给原籍国一事怀有强烈情绪的人，我想请你们思考：为什么你们认为美国人比尼日利亚人更有权利轻松接触到贝宁青铜器？
comment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句
文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

comment.sentenceEn: One study found that people responded best to comments that shifted from negative to positive, possibly because it suggested they had won somebody over.
comment.translationZh: 一项研究发现，人们对那些从负面转向正面的评价反应最佳，这可能是因为这暗示着他们已经赢得了对方的认可。
comment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第5句

comment.sentenceEn: In other words, don't read online comments .
comment.translationZh: 换句话说，不要阅读网上评论。
comment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

comment.sentenceEn: Why do people read negative Internet comments and do other things that will obviously be painful?
comment.translationZh: 为什么人们会阅读负面的网络评论，以及做其他明显会带来痛苦的事情呢？
comment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

creation.sentenceEn: Recognising the hope that science and engineering can bring was the impetus behind the creation of the Millennium Technology Prize, which is now entering its 20th year as a celebration of human ingenuity.
creation.translationZh: 认识到科学与工程所能带来的希望，是创立千禧技术奖的初衷。如今，这项彰显人类智慧的奖项已迈入第20个年头。
creation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

creation.sentenceEn: At the time of creation , no attempts were made at intentional preservation, yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as the historical record that biographers, historians, and novelists rely on.
creation.translationZh: 在创作之时，人们并未刻意进行保存，但这些模拟材料却有可能幸存下来，成为传记作者、历史学家和小说家所依赖的历史记录。
creation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

creation.sentenceEn: Taxes on low-wage labor need to be cut, and wage subsidies such as the earned income tax credit should be expanded: This would boost incomes, encourage work, reward companies for job creation , and reduce inequality.
creation.translationZh: 需要削减对低薪劳动力的税收，并扩大诸如劳动所得税收抵免等工资补贴：这将提高收入水平，鼓励就业，奖励创造就业岗位的企业，并减少不平等现象。
creation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

creation.sentenceEn: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.
creation.translationZh: 在莎士比亚出生之际，欧洲正见证着宗教戏剧的衰落，以及在古典悲剧与喜剧的启发下新戏剧形式的诞生。
creation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

creation.sentenceEn: Hill's pressure later led to the creation of national parks and green belts.
creation.translationZh: 希尔的努力后来促成了国家公园和绿化带的建立。
creation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

creation.sentenceEn: This is because the networked computer has sparked a secret war between downloading and uploading – between passive consumption and active creation – whose outcome will shape our collective future in ways we can only begin to imagine.
creation.translationZh: 这是因为联网计算机引发了一场下载与上传之间的秘密战争——一场被动消费与主动创造之间的较量——其结果将以我们才刚刚开始想象的方式塑造我们共同的未来。

creativity.sentenceEn: Combining human creativity and AI algorithms can lead to unique artistic outcomes that are beautiful to the human eye.
creativity.translationZh: 人类创意与人工智能算法的结合，能够创造出符合人类审美且独特的艺术成果。
creativity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

creativity.sentenceEn: In 2017 the association formed the Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment (ACE), an enforcement task force of about 100 detectives circling the globe to help local authorities arrest streaming pirates.
creativity.translationZh: 2017年，该协会成立了创意与娱乐联盟(ACE)，这是一个由约100名侦探组成的全球执法特遣队，旨在协助地方当局逮捕流媒体盗版者。
creativity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

creativity.sentenceEn: Some believe that AI is negatively impacting on the marketer's role by reducing creativity and removing jobs, but they are aware that it is a way of reducing costs and creating new information.
creativity.translationZh: 一些人认为，人工智能通过降低创造力和减少就业机会，对营销人员的角色产生了负面影响，但他们也意识到，人工智能是一种降低成本和创造新信息的方式。
creativity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

creativity.sentenceEn: In one study, participants completed a battery of eight tasks, including four that tapped reflective thinking (discerning rules, comprehending vocabulary) and four that tapped intuition and creativity (generating new products or figures of speech).
creativity.translationZh: 在一项研究中，参与者完成了一系列共八项任务，其中四项涉及反思性思维（如识别规则、理解词汇），另外四项则涉及直觉与创造力（如生成新产品或修辞手法）。
creativity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

creativity.sentenceEn: Following the explosion of creativity in Florence during the 14th century known as the Renaissance, the modern world saw a departure from what it had once known.
creativity.translationZh: 14世纪的佛罗伦萨爆发了一场被称为文艺复兴的创作热潮，此后现代世界开始背离其曾经熟知的一切。
creativity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

capture.sentenceEn: After he's captured the butterfly taking off, he layers 10 to 15 frames together in Photoshop.
capture.translationZh: 在捕捉到蝴蝶起飞的瞬间后，他在Photoshop中将10到15帧画面叠加在一起。

capture.sentenceEn: A children's author and poet who had become a keen amateur photographer, Peters watched the butterflies and idly wondered if he could capture them in flight.
capture.translationZh: 彼得斯是一位儿童文学作家兼诗人，同时也是一位热忱的业余摄影师。他观察着蝴蝶，随意地想着能否捕捉到它们飞行的瞬间。

capture.sentenceEn: A butterfly takes off so quickly it is still impossible to react quickly enough to capture that take-off but if he half-presses the shutter, the camera saves the 70 previous frames before the moment he actually takes the picture.
capture.translationZh: 蝴蝶起飞速度极快，快到让人来不及反应捕捉这一起飞瞬间，但如果他半按快门，相机就会保存他实际拍照前的70帧画面。

capture.sentenceEn: Despite these challenges, Jackson captured dozens of striking photos, ranging from majestic images like his now-famous snapshot of Old Faithful, to casual portraits of expedition members at the camp.
capture.translationZh: 尽管面临这些挑战，杰克逊还是拍摄了数十张引人注目的照片，既有他如今闻名遐迩的老忠实泉等壮丽景观，也有探险队成员在营地的随意肖像。

capture.sentenceEn: In addition to the entourage of scientists, the team also included artists: Painter Thomas Moran and photographer Jackson were charged with capturing this astounding natural beauty and sharing it with the world.
capture.translationZh: 除了随行的科学家团队外，这支考察队还包括艺术家：画家托马斯·莫兰和摄影师杰克逊的任务是捕捉这令人惊叹的自然美景并向世界展示。

consumption.sentenceEn: To become much more self-sufficient, the UK would need to drastically reduce its consumption of animal foods, and probably also farm more intensively—meaning fewer green fields and more factory-style production.
consumption.translationZh: 要大幅提高粮食自给率，英国需要大幅减少动物性食品的消费，而且可能还需要采取更集约化的 farming 方式——这意味着绿地减少，工厂式生产增多。
consumption.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

consumption.sentenceEn: First, most people do not realise that there are strong commercial agendas at work to keep them in passive consumption mode.
consumption.translationZh: 首先，大多数人没有意识到，一些强大的商业议程正在起作用，目的是让他们一直处于被动消费模式。
consumption.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

consumption.sentenceEn: Laughter does produce short-term changes in the function of the heart and its blood vessels, boosting heart rate and oxygen consumption .
consumption.translationZh: 笑的确会使心脏及其血管功能产生短期变化，提高心率和氧气消耗量。
consumption.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

consumption.sentenceEn: Professor Terence Stephenson, president of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health, said that the consumption of unhealthy food should be seen to be just as damaging as smoking or excessive drinking.
consumption.translationZh: 英国皇家儿科与儿童健康学院院长特伦斯·斯蒂芬森教授表示，食用不健康食品的危害应被视为与吸烟或过量饮酒同样严重。
consumption.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

consumption.sentenceEn: The first and most important is the consumer's growing preference for eating out: the consumption of food and drink in places other than homes has risen from about 32 percent of total consumption in 1995 to 35 percent in 2000 and is expected to approach 38 percent by 2005.
consumption.translationZh: 首要且最重要的是消费者越来越倾向于外出就餐：在家庭以外场所的食品饮料消费占总消费的比例已从1995年的约32%上升到2000年的35%，预计到2005年将接近38%。

consumption.sentenceEn: These issues all have root causes in human behavior: all require behavioral change and social innovations, as well as technological development. Stemming climate change, for example, is as much about changing consumption patterns and promoting tax acceptance as it is about developing clean energy.
consumption.translationZh: 这些问题的根源都在于人类行为：所有问题的解决不仅需要技术发展，还需要行为改变和社会创新。例如，遏制气候变化既要发展清洁能源，也要改变消费模式和提高税收接受度。

contrast.sentenceEn: An infant born to a hunter-gatherer society could have more than ten caregivers—this contrasts starkly to nursery settings in the UK where regulations call for a ratio of one carer to four children aged two to three.
contrast.translationZh: 一个出生在狩猎采集社会的婴儿可能有十多位照料者——这与英国托儿所的情况形成鲜明对比，英国的规定要求2至3岁儿童的照料比例为1:4。
contrast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

contrast.sentenceEn: By contrast , in hunter-gatherer societies adults other than the parents can provide almost half of a child's care.
contrast.translationZh: 相比之下，在狩猎采集社会中，父母以外的成年人可以提供儿童近一半的照料。
contrast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

contrast.sentenceEn: In contrast , suppose you give a reasonable argument: that full-time workers should not have to live in poverty.
contrast.translationZh: 相反，假设你提出一个合理的论点：全职工作者不应被迫生活在贫困中。

contrast.sentenceEn: In contrast , only five of the 30 children paired with the "unreliable" tester participated in a follow-up activity.
contrast.translationZh: 相比之下，在30名与“不可靠”测试者配对的儿童中，只有5名参与了后续活动。
contrast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

contrast.sentenceEn: The Olympic bidders, by contrast , wanted to get more people doing sport and to produce more elite athletes.
contrast.translationZh: 相比之下，奥运会的申办者则希望让更多人参与体育运动，并培养更多精英运动员。
contrast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

contrast.sentenceEn: In contrast to France's actions, Denmark's fashion industry agreed last month on rules and sanctions regarding the age, health, and other characteristics of models.
contrast.translationZh: 与法国的举措形成对比的是，丹麦时尚界上个月就模特的年龄、健康及其他特征达成了相关规定与处罚措施。
contrast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

crop.sentenceEn: In an effort to support restoration programmes, specialists are developing supplies of seeds and seedlings, maintaining gene banks and sequencing the genomes of indigenous trees and other crops .
crop.translationZh: 为了支持恢复计划，专家们正在增加种子和树苗的供应，维护基因库，并对本土树木和其他作物的基因组进行测序。
crop.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

crop.sentenceEn: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that's working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.
crop.translationZh: 据代表好莱坞各大制片厂的行业组织——美国电影协会（MPA）称，由于没有视频制作成本，非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近90%。该协会正致力于打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台。
crop.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

crop.sentenceEn: As the latest crop of students pen their undergraduate application form and weigh up their options, it may be worth considering just how the point, purpose and value of a degree has changed and what Generation Z need to consider as they start the third stage of their educational journey.
crop.translationZh: 当最新一批学生正在填写本科申请表并权衡各种选择时，或许值得思考一下：学位的意义、目的和价值究竟发生了怎样的变化？以及Z世代在开启他们教育旅程的第三阶段时需要考虑哪些因素？
crop.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

crop.sentenceEn: "I'm excited about our progress," says Brown, who harvests eggs for Denver-based Nest Fresh Eggs and is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat.
crop.translationZh: 拉里·布朗为总部位于丹佛的Nest Fresh Eggs公司供应鸡蛋，他表示：“我对我们的进展感到兴奋。”目前，他正在种植更多覆盖作物，以吸引蠕虫和蟋蟀供鸡食用。
crop.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

crop.sentenceEn: Even if we converted all the suitable land to fields of fruit and veg—which would involve taking out all the nature reserves and removing thousands of people from their homes—we would achieve only a 30 per cent boost in crop production.
crop.translationZh: 即便我们将所有适宜耕种的土地都改种水果和蔬菜——这意味着要清除所有自然保护区并让数千人背井离乡——农作物产量也只能增加30%。
crop.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

crop.sentenceEn: There is a good reason why the UK is dominated by animal husbandry: most of its terrain doesn't have the right soil or climate to grow crops on a commercial basis.
crop.translationZh: 英国畜牧业占据主导地位是有充分原因的：该国大部分地区的土壤和气候条件并不适合进行商业化农作物种植。
crop.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

crucial.sentenceEn: But demonstrating the efficacy of science will be crucial if we are to solve humanity's greatest challenges.
crucial.translationZh: 然而，若要解决人类面临的最大挑战，证明科学的有效性将至关重要。
crucial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

crucial.sentenceEn: New research suggests that smell is a crucial factor in guiding elephants—and probably other herbivores—to the best food resources.
crucial.translationZh: 新研究表明，嗅觉是引导大象——很可能还有其他食草动物——找到最佳食物资源的关键因素。
crucial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

crucial.sentenceEn: And it's a reminder that the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program has long been crucial as the means to transcend the influence of deep-pocketed special interests in neighboring states.
crucial.translationZh: 这也提醒我们，长期以来，美国环保署参与切萨皮克湾项目至关重要，因为它是超越邻州财力雄厚的特殊利益集团影响的重要手段。
crucial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

crucial.sentenceEn: The zoology program at my university attracts students for whom zoo visits were the crucial formative experience that led them to major in biological sciences.
crucial.translationZh: 我校动物学专业吸引的学生中，很多人正是因为参观动物园的宝贵经历，才决定主修生物科学。
crucial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

crucial.sentenceEn: But that doesn't mean crucial ethical issues involving AI aren't at hand.
crucial.translationZh: 但这并不意味着人工智能相关的关键伦理问题尚未到来。
crucial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

crucial.sentenceEn: Foreign bureaus play a crucial role in the newspaper business.
crucial.translationZh: 驻外记者站在报业中扮演着至关重要的角色。

cannot.sentenceEn: Simply, there are people in Nigeria who cannot travel to the Smithsonian Institution to see that part of their history and culture represented by the Benin Bronzes.
cannot.translationZh: 简而言之，尼日利亚有些人无法前往史密森学会，去亲眼目睹贝宁青铜器所代表的那部分本国历史与文化。
cannot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

cannot.sentenceEn: Although good TV shows can help stir children's interest in conservation, they cannot replace the excitement of a zoo visit as an intense, immersive and interactive experience.
cannot.translationZh: 尽管优秀的电视节目有助于激发孩子们对动物保护的兴趣，但它们无法取代动物园参观所带来的那种强烈、沉浸式且互动性强的体验所带来的兴奋感。
cannot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

cannot.sentenceEn: Psychologist Nina Strohminger at the University of Pennsylvania, who was not involved in the study, says she wants the effect to be real but cannot rule out some unknown confounding variable.
cannot.translationZh: 宾夕法尼亚大学的心理学家尼娜·斯特罗明格并未参与这项研究，她说她希望这种效果是真实的，但不能排除一些未知的混淆变量。
cannot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

cannot.sentenceEn: There is no reason why everyone cannot be welcomed on Mauna Kea to embrace their cultural heritage and to study the stars.
cannot.translationZh: 没有理由不欢迎所有人来到莫纳克亚山，去拥抱各自的文化遗产并研究星辰。
cannot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

cannot.sentenceEn: The TSA cannot continue diverting resources into underused PreCheck lanes while most of the traveling public suffers in unnecessary lines.
cannot.translationZh: 运输安全管理局不能再继续将资源投入到利用率不足的预检通道，而与此同时，大多数旅客却在不必要的长队中苦苦等待。
cannot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

casino.translationZh: 赌场将他视为优质客户，向他发放了一张"乐趣卡"。在赌场使用这张卡可以累积积分兑换餐饮，同时也能让赌场追踪持卡人的赌博活动。
casino.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
casino.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

casino.sentenceEn: Noting the "medical/psychological" nature of problem gambling behavior, the letter said that before being readmitted to the casino he would have to present medical/psychological information demonstrating that patronizing the casino would pose no threat to his safety or well-being.
casino.translationZh: 该信件指出问题赌博行为具有'医疗/心理'性质，并说明在他重新进入赌场之前，必须提供医疗/心理方面的信息，以证明光顾赌场不会对其安全或健康构成威胁。
casino.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
casino.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

casino.sentenceEn: Nevertheless, Williams's suit charges that the casino , knowing he was "helplessly addicted to gambling," intentionally worked to "lure" him to "engage in conduct against his will." Well.
casino.translationZh: 然而，威廉姆斯在诉讼中指控赌场明明知道他“无可救药地沉迷于赌博”，却故意“引诱”他“违背自己的意愿参与赌博”。好吧。
casino.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
casino.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

casino.sentenceEn: Forty-four states have lotteries, 29 have casinos , and most of these states are to varying degrees dependent on – you might say addicted to – revenues from wagering.
casino.translationZh: 美国44个州发行彩票，29个州设有赌场，而这些州中的大多数都在不同程度上依赖——甚至可以说沉溺于——博彩业带来的收入。
casino.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
casino.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

casino.sentenceEn: In March 1998, a friend of Williams's got him involuntarily confined to a treatment center for addictions, and wrote to inform the casino of Williams's gambling problem.
casino.translationZh: 1998年3月，威廉姆斯的一位朋友强行将他送进了戒瘾治疗中心，并写信告知赌场威廉姆斯的赌博问题。
casino.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
casino.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

casino.sentenceEn: Although no such evidence was presented, the casino's marketing department continued to pepper him with mailings. And he entered the casino and used his Fun Card without being detected.
casino.translationZh: 尽管威廉斯并未提供此类证明，赌场的营销部门却继续向他狂发邮件。而他则能进入赌场并使用他的'乐趣卡'，且未被察觉。
casino.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）

category.sentenceEn: More recently there were similar doubts about probiotics and plant-based meats, but both have exploded into major supermarket categories .
category.translationZh: 就在不久前，人们对益生菌和植物基肉类也有类似的疑虑，但这两类产品如今都已迅速崛起，成为超市中的主要品类。
category.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

category.sentenceEn: This year, it was proposed that the system be changed: Horizon 2020, a new program to be enacted in 2014, would not have such a category .
category.translationZh: 今年，有人提议改变这一体系：将于2014年启动的新计划"地平线2020"将不再设置这一专项。
category.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

category.sentenceEn: The European Union Framework funding programs have long had a category specifically targeted at social scientists.
category.translationZh: 欧盟框架资助计划长期以来一直设有专门面向社会科学家的资助类别。
category.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

category.sentenceEn: We divide newcomers into two categories : legal or illegal, good or bad.
category.translationZh: 我们将新来者分为两类：合法或非法，好或坏。
category.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

category.sentenceEn: We don't need more categories , but we need to change the way we think about categories .
category.translationZh: 我们不需要更多的类别，而是需要改变我们对类别的思考方式。
category.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

category.sentenceEn: The idea is to force social scientists to integrate their work with other categories , including health and demographic change; food security; marine research and the bio-economy; clean, efficient energy; and inclusive, innovative and secure societies.
category.translationZh: 其目的是促使社会科学家将其研究工作与其他领域相结合，包括健康与人口变化、粮食安全、海洋研究与生物经济、清洁高效能源以及包容、创新和安全的社会。

centre.sentenceEn: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres , which can help business owners and entrepreneurs.
centre.translationZh: 一些图书馆设有商业和知识产权中心，可以为企业主和创业者提供帮助。
centre.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

centre.sentenceEn: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
centre.translationZh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
centre.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

centre.sentenceEn: There are around 40 official do-it-yourself biology centres across the globe in locations including Paris, London, Sydney, and Tel Aviv.
centre.translationZh: 全球约有40个官方的自助生物学中心，分布在巴黎、伦敦、悉尼和特拉维夫等城市。
centre.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

centre.sentenceEn: And it is equally true that science's unrelenting appetite for information has caused a mushrooming of energy-intensive data centres around the world.
centre.translationZh: 同样真实的是，科学对信息永不满足的渴求已导致全球能源密集型数据中心如雨后春笋般涌现。
centre.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

centre.sentenceEn: Ohio State University allowed its students to navigate the Oval, a lawn in the centre of campus, freely, then proceeded to pave the desire paths, creating a web of effective routes students had established.
centre.translationZh: 俄亥俄州立大学允许学生们在校园中心的椭圆形草坪（the Oval）自由穿行，随后学校将这些学生们自然踩出的小径铺设成路，形成了一张由学生自行开辟的高效路线网络。
centre.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

centre.sentenceEn: But implementation of existing HAPs has been uneven, according to a report from the Centre for Policy Research.
centre.translationZh: 但政策研究中心的一份报告显示，现有健康行动计划的实施情况参差不齐。
centre.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

clearly.sentenceEn: Roman lamps and Roman chariots are very different from LED strips and sports cars, but Roman nails are still clearly nails.
clearly.translationZh: 罗马的灯具和战车与如今的LED灯带和跑车有着天壤之别，但罗马的钉子至今仍清晰可辨，依然是钉子。
clearly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

clearly.sentenceEn: Goodall added: "While food production and biodiversity health are clearly of critical importance, we need our land to also provide secure supplies of wood for construction, manufacturing and contribute to net zero."
clearly.translationZh: 古德尔补充道：“虽然粮食生产和生物多样性健康显然至关重要，但我们也需要土地能够提供稳定的木材供应，用于建筑、制造业并助力实现净零目标。”
clearly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

clearly.sentenceEn: The newly revised Danish Fashion Ethical Charter clearly states: "We are aware of and take responsibility for the impact the fashion industry has on body ideals, especially on young people."
clearly.translationZh: 新修订的《丹麦时尚伦理宪章》明确指出：“我们认识到时尚产业对体型理想，尤其是对年轻人的影响，并对此承担责任。”
clearly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

clearly.sentenceEn: Clearly you try to comprehend, in the sense of identifying meanings for individual words and working out relationships between them, drawing on your implicit knowledge of English grammar.
clearly.translationZh: 显然，你会尝试去理解——具体来说，就是识别每个单词的含义，理清它们之间的关系，并运用你对英语语法的隐性知识。
clearly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

clearly.sentenceEn: The role that weather plays in formation flight has not yet been clearly defined.
clearly.translationZh: 天气在编队飞行中所起的作用尚未明确界定。

clearly.sentenceEn: After you have clearly and adequately developed the body of your paper, pay particular attention to the introductory and concluding paragraphs. It's probably best to write the introduction last, after you know precisely what you are introducing. Concluding paragraphs demand equal attention because they leave the reader with a final impression.
clearly.translationZh: 在清晰且充分地完成论文主体部分后，要特别注意引言和结论段落。最好是在确切知道自己要引入什么内容之后再写引言，也就是把引言留到最后写。结论段落同样需要重点打磨，因为它们会给读者留下最终印象。
clearly.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

cloning.sentenceEn: However, there are still no forecasts for when faster-than-light travel will be available, or when human cloning will be perfected, or when time travel will be possible.
cloning.translationZh: 然而，对于超光速旅行何时能实现、人类克隆何时能完善，或是时间旅行何时能成为可能，目前仍无预测。
cloning.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
cloning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

cloning.sentenceEn: The panel has not yet reached agreement on a crucial question, however, whether to recommend legislation that would make it a crime for private funding to be used for human cloning .
cloning.translationZh: 然而，该委员会尚未就一个关键问题达成一致，即是否建议立法将私人资金用于克隆人定为犯罪行为。
cloning.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
cloning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

cloning.sentenceEn: NBAC will ask that Clinton's 90-day ban on federal funds for human cloning be extended indefinitely, and possibly that it be made law.
cloning.translationZh: 国家生物伦理咨询委员会（NBAC）将要求把克林顿总统颁布的为期90天的联邦资金用于人类克隆研究的禁令无限期延长，并且可能将其立法。
cloning.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
cloning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

cloning.sentenceEn: In a draft preface to the recommendations, discussed at the 17 May meeting, Shapiro suggested that the panel had found a broad consensus that it would be "morally unacceptable to attempt to create a human child by adult nuclear cloning ."
cloning.translationZh: 在5月17日会议上讨论的建议书草稿序言中，夏皮罗表示，委员会已达成广泛共识，认为“试图通过成人细胞核克隆技术来创造人类婴儿在道德上是不可接受的”。
cloning.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
cloning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

cloning.sentenceEn: But NBAC members are planning to word the recommendation narrowly to avoid new restrictions on research that involves the cloning of human DNA or cells—routine in molecular biology.
cloning.translationZh: 但是NBAC成员计划对建议的措辞进行严格限定，以避免对涉及克隆人类DNA或细胞的研究施加新的限制——这类研究在分子生物学中属于常规操作。
cloning.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
cloning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

cloning.sentenceEn: But they were divided on whether to go further by calling for a federal law that would impose a complete ban on human cloning .
cloning.translationZh: 但在是否应进一步呼吁制定联邦法律以全面禁止人类克隆这一问题上，他们存在分歧。
cloning.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
cloning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

confidence.sentenceEn: Additionally, clothing can impact our confidence levels.
confidence.translationZh: 此外，穿着打扮也会影响我们的自信程度。
confidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

confidence.sentenceEn: It may be a well-informed, well-researched opinion, but it's still an opinion, so talk tentatively and slightly understate your confidence .
confidence.translationZh: 你的观点可能是基于充分了解和深入研究得出的，但终究只是个人观点，因此表达时应措辞委婉，并略微收敛自信。
confidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

confidence.sentenceEn: It can catch someone's attention in a crowded room, "Eye contact and smile" can signal availability and confidence , a common-sense notion supported in studies by psychologist Monica Moore.
confidence.translationZh: 在拥挤的房间里，眼神交流可以吸引他人的注意；而“眼神交流配合微笑”则能传递出乐于交往和自信的信号——心理学家莫妮卡·摩尔的研究也证实了这一常识性观点。
confidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

confidence.sentenceEn: With characteristic confidence , Dickens successfully insisted that Seymour's pictures illustrate his own story instead.
confidence.translationZh: 狄更斯以其特有的自信，坚持要求西摩的插画应转而描绘他自己的故事，这一要求最终获得了成功。

confidence.sentenceEn: Mental health is the seed that contains self-esteem – confidence in ourselves and an ability to trust in our common sense.
confidence.translationZh: 心理健康是孕育自尊的种子——它包含着对自己的信心和相信自己常识判断的能力。
confidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

conservative.sentenceEn: Yet that demand has been almost impossible to fill—in part because of pushback from broadband providers, anti-regulatory conservatives and the courts.
conservative.translationZh: 然而，这一诉求几乎不可能实现——部分原因是来自宽带提供商、反监管的保守派以及法院的抵制。
conservative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

conservative.sentenceEn: Seven months and one election day later, a new conservative city council suspended enforcement of the clean air zone, a first step toward its possible demise.
conservative.translationZh: 七个月后，经过一场选举，新当选的保守派市议会暂停了清洁空气区的执行，这是该区域可能走向终结的第一步。
conservative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

conservative.sentenceEn: The Conservatives' planning reform explicitly gives rural development priority over conservation, even authorising "off-plan" building where local people might object.
conservative.translationZh: 保守党的规划改革明确将农村开发置于环境保护之上，甚至批准在当地人可能反对的地方进行'计划外'建设。
conservative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

conservative.sentenceEn: Its Campaign to Protect Rural England struck terror into many local Conservative parties.
conservative.translationZh: 该党发起的“保护英格兰乡村运动”令许多地方保守党闻风丧胆。
conservative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

conservative.sentenceEn: Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas – such as free markets and self-reliance – as falling outside the boundaries of routine, and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation.
conservative.translationZh: 如今，教授们通常将对历史的进步主义解读和进步主义公共政策视为恰当的研究课题，同时将保守派或古典自由主义思想——如自由市场和自力更生——描绘成超出常规研究范畴，有时甚至是超出正当学术探讨界限的内容。
conservative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

conservative.sentenceEn: Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
conservative.translationZh: 虽然合理的改革建议早已存在，但管理律师行业的州级机构却过于保守，不愿实施这些建议。
conservative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

consume.sentenceEn: According to the International Energy Agency, these buildings now consume about 1 per cent of the world's electricity.
consume.translationZh: 根据国际能源署的数据，这些建筑目前消耗约占全球1%的电力。
consume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

consume.sentenceEn: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol.
consume.translationZh: 然而，人造草坪的支持者指出，天然草坪也会对环境产生影响，因为它们需要修剪，因此通常会消耗电力或汽油。
consume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

consume.sentenceEn: That supplies 80 per cent of what is consumed , so even covering the whole country in livestock farms wouldn't allow us to cover all our meat and dairy needs.
consume.translationZh: 这些土地产出的肉奶产品满足了英国人80%的消费需求，因此即使将全国都变成养殖场，也无法满足我们对肉类和乳制品的全部需求。
consume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

consume.sentenceEn: Just 23 per cent of the fruit and vegetables consumed in the UK are currently home-grown, so even with the most extreme measures we could meet only 30 per cent of our fresh produce needs.
consume.translationZh: 目前英国消费的水果和蔬菜中仅23%是本土种植的，因此即使采取最极端的措施，我们也只能满足30%的新鲜农产品需求。
consume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

consume.sentenceEn: From 1998 to 2000, 14.5 percent of the fruit Americans consumed was imported.
consume.translationZh: 1998年至2000年间，美国人消费的水果中有14.5%是进口的。
consume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

consume.sentenceEn: Of course, it is precisely these superfluous things that define human culture and ultimately what it is to be human. Downloading and consuming culture requires great skills, but failing to move beyond downloading is to strip oneself of a defining constituent of humanity.
consume.translationZh: 当然，正是这些看似多余的事物定义了人类文化，并最终定义了何为人类。下载和消费文化需要高超的技能，但如果无法超越下载的阶段，我们就剥夺了自己身为人类的一个关键特质。

curiosity.sentenceEn: But by utilising the natural curiosity of the general public it is possible to overcome many of these challenges by engaging non-scientists directly in the research process.
curiosity.translationZh: 但通过利用公众的天然好奇心，可以让非科研人员直接参与研究过程，从而克服其中许多挑战。
curiosity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

curiosity.sentenceEn: Having asserted your opinion (as a position, not as a fact), demonstrate equal curiosity about other views.
curiosity.translationZh: 在表达完你的观点（是作为一种立场，而非事实）之后，要对他人的看法表现出同样的好奇心。
curiosity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第4句

curiosity.sentenceEn: The 17th and 18th centuries were times of radical change and curiosity .
curiosity.translationZh: 17和18世纪是充满彻底变革与探索精神的时代。
curiosity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

curiosity.sentenceEn: Curiosity is often considered a good instinct – it can lead to new scientific advances, for instance – but sometimes such inquiry can backfire.
curiosity.translationZh: 好奇心通常被视为一种良好的本能——例如，它能带来新的科学进展——但有时这种探究可能会适得其反。
curiosity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

curiosity.sentenceEn: "Thinking about long-term consequences is key to reducing the possible negative effects of curiosity ," Hsee says.
curiosity.translationZh: 奚恺元说：“思考长远后果是减少好奇心可能带来的负面影响的关键。”
curiosity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

curiosity.sentenceEn: The new research reveals that the need to know is so strong that people will seek to satisfy their curiosity even when it is clear the answer will hurt.
curiosity.translationZh: 这项新研究揭示，人们求知的欲望非常强烈，即便明知答案会令人不快，他们仍会试图满足自己的好奇心。
curiosity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

characteristic.sentenceEn: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics .
characteristic.translationZh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
characteristic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

characteristic.sentenceEn: The volatile chemicals produced by plants can be carried a long way, and they are very characteristic : Each plant or tree has its own particular odor signature.
characteristic.translationZh: 植物产生的挥发性化学物质可以传播很远，并且具有非常独特的特征：每种植物或树木都有其特定的气味特征。
characteristic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

characteristic.sentenceEn: As fewer such workers enter the country, the characteristics of the agricultural workforce are changing.
characteristic.translationZh: 随着这类工人进入美国的人数减少，农业劳动力的构成特征正在发生变化。
characteristic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

characteristic.sentenceEn: With characteristic confidence, Dickens successfully insisted that Seymour's pictures illustrate his own story instead.
characteristic.translationZh: 狄更斯以其特有的自信，坚持要求西摩的插画应转而描绘他自己的故事，这一要求最终获得了成功。

characteristic.sentenceEn: In contrast to France's actions, Denmark's fashion industry agreed last month on rules and sanctions regarding the age, health, and other characteristics of models.
characteristic.translationZh: 与法国的举措形成对比的是，丹麦时尚界上个月就模特的年龄、健康及其他特征达成了相关规定与处罚措施。
characteristic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

characteristic.sentenceEn: They shared some characteristics of abstract art.
characteristic.translationZh: 它们具有抽象艺术的某些特征。

code.sentenceEn: It listed many documents in code that had been captured from the French army of Spain, and whose secrets had been revealed by the work of one George Scovell, an officer in British headquarters.
code.translationZh: 该附录列出了许多从西班牙法军手中缴获的加密文件，而这些文件的秘密正是由英国总部的一名军官——乔治·斯科维尔的工作所揭开的。
code.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

code.sentenceEn: I became convinced that this story was every bit as exciting and significant as that of Enigma and the breaking of German codes in the Second World War.
code.translationZh: 我开始相信，这个故事与二战中恩尼格玛密码机以及破解德国密码的事迹一样激动人心且意义重大。
code.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

code.sentenceEn: It was also, and this is unknown even to many people well read about the period, a battle between those who made codes and those who broke them.
code.translationZh: 然而鲜为人知的是——即便是对那个时期有深入了解的人也未必知晓——这场战争同时也是一场密码编制者与密码破解者之间的较量。
code.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

code.sentenceEn: Just as the code breaking has its wider relevance in the struggle for Spain, so his attempts to make his way up the promotion ladder speak volumes about British society.
code.translationZh: 正如密码破译在西班牙争夺战中具有更广泛的意义一样，斯科维尔在军阶晋升之路上的种种努力也充分反映了英国社会的风貌。
code.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

code.sentenceEn: Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, "you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions," notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI.
code.translationZh: 新加坡某机构首席执行官陈杰豪指出，只要决策是基于海量数据做出的，“你很快就会陷入诸多伦理问题之中”。该机构正协助政府制定人工智能伦理使用自愿准则。
code.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

code.sentenceEn: Much more could be done to encourage "long-termism," such as changes in the tax code and quicker disclosure of stock acquisitions.
code.translationZh: 要鼓励“长期主义”，我们还可以做更多事情，例如修改税法和加快股票收购信息的披露。
code.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

complain.sentenceEn: People often complain that plastics are too durable.
complain.translationZh: 人们常抱怨塑料太过耐用。

complain.sentenceEn: People complained that buses were late and infrequent.
complain.translationZh: 人们抱怨公交车晚点且班次稀少。
complain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

complain.sentenceEn: "They bought the seedlings and closed them down," complained Paul Arnold, a partner at San Francisco-based Switch Ventures, putting an end to businesses that might one day turn into competitors.
complain.translationZh: 总部位于旧金山的Switch Ventures合伙人保罗·阿诺德抱怨道：“他们买下这些幼苗企业，然后就把它们扼杀了”，终止了那些有朝一日可能成为竞争对手的企业。
complain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

complain.sentenceEn: Even so, employers complain they aren't given all the workers they need.
complain.translationZh: 即便如此，雇主们仍抱怨他们没有获得所需的全部工人。
complain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

complain.translationZh: 多年来，美国农民一直在抱怨劳动力短缺问题。
complain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

complain.sentenceEn: Only strong people prefer to smile and value their life instead of crying and complaining about something.
complain.translationZh: 唯有强者才会选择微笑面对、珍视生活，而非怨天尤人、悲戚抱怨。
complain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

completely.sentenceEn: And, as our research emphasizes, tipping now seems to be more coercive, less generous and often completely dissociated from service quality.
completely.translationZh: 而且，正如我们的研究所强调的，如今的小费似乎更具强制性，少了些慷慨，并且往往与服务质量完全脱节。
completely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

completely.sentenceEn: When you find yourself well off a trail, but not in a completely unfamiliar area, you have to answer two questions: Which way is downhill, in this particular area?
completely.translationZh: 当你发现自己远离了步道，但又并非身处完全陌生的区域时，你必须回答两个问题：在这片特定区域，哪条路是下坡？
completely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

completely.sentenceEn: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world often causes students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year.
completely.translationZh: 如今，要求学生立即上大学的普遍社会压力，加之在这个瞬息万变的世界中日益增高的期望，往往导致学生们完全忽视了间隔年的可能性。
completely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

completely.sentenceEn: Those things might be social, sporting, creative or completely random (dancing around the living room, anyone?) – it doesn't matter, so long as they're enjoyable, and not likely to have negative side effects, such as drinking too much alcohol or going on a wild spending spree if you're on a tight budget.
completely.translationZh: 这些活动可以是社交聚会、体育运动、创意创作，或者完全随性的事情（比如在客厅里跳跳舞，有人想试试吗？）—— 具体是什么并不重要，只要能带来乐趣，并且不会产生负面影响就行，比如过量饮酒，或者在预算紧张时疯狂购物。
completely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

completely.sentenceEn: I do completely agree that fears are just the product of our luxuriant imagination.
completely.translationZh: 我完全同意，恐惧不过是我们丰富想象力的产物。

completely.sentenceEn: In order to study particular cultures as completely as possible, he became skilled in linguistics, the study of languages, and in physical anthropology, the study of human biology and anatomy.
completely.translationZh: 为了尽可能全面地研究特定文化，博厄斯精通了语言学（即对语言的研究）和体质人类学（即对人类生物学与解剖学的研究）。

continent.sentenceEn: But when Swetnam enrolled in graduate school at the University of Arizona's Laboratory of Tree-Ring Research, he was surprised to find a record of repeated blazes dating back hundreds of years before European colonists arrived on the continent .
continent.translationZh: 但当斯韦特南进入亚利桑那大学年轮研究实验室攻读研究生时，他惊讶地发现，早在欧洲殖民者抵达美洲大陆之前的数百年间，这里就有过多次火灾记录。
continent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

continent.sentenceEn: In 2022, Swetnam and other scientists teamed up to compile a database of fire-scarred trees from across the continent .
continent.translationZh: 2022 年，斯韦特纳姆与其他科学家合作，编制了一个涵盖整个大陆的火灾痕迹树木数据库。
continent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

continent.sentenceEn: They then traced how the animals spread across the rest of the continent into Europe and Asia about 2,500 years later.
continent.translationZh: 随后，他们追踪了这些动物在大约 2,500 年后是如何穿过大陆其余地区，进而扩散到欧洲和亚洲的。
continent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

continent.sentenceEn: This movement, driven by powerful and diverse motivations, built a nation out of a wilderness and, by its nature, shaped the character and destiny of an uncharted continent .
continent.translationZh: 这场移民运动由各种强大的动机驱动，在一片荒野之上建立起一个国家，并且凭借其本质，塑造了这片未知大陆的性格与命运。
continent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

continent.sentenceEn: But the force of geographic conditions peculiar to America, the interplay of the varied national groups upon one another, and the sheer difficulty of maintaining old-world ways in a raw, new continent caused significant changes.
continent.translationZh: 但是，美国特有的地理环境因素、不同民族群体之间的相互影响，以及在这片原始的新大陆上维持旧世界生活方式的巨大困难，都带来了显著的变化。
continent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

continent.sentenceEn: Now even the project's greatest cheerleaders talk of a continent facing a "Bermuda triangle" of debt, population decline and lower growth.
continent.translationZh: 如今，即便是该项目最坚定的支持者也在谈论欧洲大陆正面临债务、人口减少和经济增长放缓这一“百慕大三角”。
continent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

contribution.sentenceEn: Not only does understanding the equines' genetic makeup help reveal their contribution to human history, but it also might improve their management in the future, as climate change alters the planet's environment, write the authors.
contribution.translationZh: 作者写道，了解马科动物的基因构成不仅有助于揭示它们对人类历史的贡献，而且随着气候变化改变地球环境，这还可能改善未来对它们的管理。
contribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

contribution.sentenceEn: Appreciating the older contributions as you suggest future innovations helps bolster the credibility of your idea.
contribution.translationZh: 在提出未来创新建议的同时，对前人的贡献表示赞赏，有助于增强你的想法的可信度。
contribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第4句

contribution.sentenceEn: On top of this, they produce value from their extensive educational programs, their positive impact on the climate through carbon sequestration, their contribution to our cultural and artistic life, and of course through tourism.

contribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

contribution.translationZh: 该公司表示，他们最常用的方式包括削减总体开支、购买人寿保险或最大限度地增加对退休账户的供款。
contribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

cooperation.translationZh: 2009年，考古学家克里斯桑西·加卢和乔恩·亨德森与希腊文化部合作，重启了对帕夫洛佩特里的发掘工作。
cooperation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

cooperation.translationZh: 针对这些众多单边措施，经济合作与发展组织（OECD）目前正与131个国家合作，以期在2020年底前就一项国际解决方案达成共识。
cooperation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

cooperation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

cooperation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

One oft-debated cure for this labor shortage remains as implausible as it's been all along: Native U.S. workers won't be returning to the farm.
cure.translationZh: 关于劳动力短缺，有一个常被讨论的解决方案始终如一地不切实际：美国本土工人不会回到农场。
cure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

cure.sentenceEn: Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity, leading to lives of fulfilment and opportunity for all.
cure.translationZh: 科学技术将治愈人类所有的弊病，为所有人带来充实且充满机遇的生活。
