cure.sentenceEn: But in her new book Join the Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure , in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.
cure.translationZh: 但在蒂娜·罗森伯格的新书《加入俱乐部》中，她提出同侪压力也可以成为一种积极力量，这要通过她所说的“社会治疗”来实现——即组织机构和官员利用群体动态的力量来帮助个人改善生活，甚至可能改善整个世界。
cure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

cure.sentenceEn: Rosenberg, the recipient of a Pulitzer Prize, offers a host of examples of the social cure in action: In South Carolina, a state-sponsored antismoking program called Rage Against the Haze sets out to make cigarettes uncool.
cure.translationZh: 普利策奖得主罗森伯格列举了许多正在实施的社会疗法实例：在南卡罗来纳州，一个由州政府资助的名为“怒对烟雾”的反吸烟项目旨在让香烟变得不再流行。
cure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

cure.sentenceEn: And that's the problem with a social cure engineered from the outside: in the real world, as in school, we insist on choosing our own friends.
cure.translationZh: 而这正是外部设计的社会疗法所存在的问题：在现实世界中，就像在学校里一样，我们坚持要自己选择朋友。
cure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

celebrity.sentenceEn: AI can also be used to identify the lifestyle choices of customers regarding their hobbies, favourite celebrities , and fashions to provide unique content in marketing messages put out through social media.
celebrity.translationZh: 人工智能还可用于识别客户在爱好、喜爱的名人及时尚方面的生活方式选择，从而为通过社交媒体发布的营销信息提供独特内容。
celebrity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

celebrity.sentenceEn: They're part of a bunch of celebrities starring in a new video for World Environment Day – encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery to combat the plastics crisis.
celebrity.translationZh: 他们与众多名人共同出演了一部为世界环境日制作的新宣传片，旨在鼓励作为消费者的你更换吸管和餐具等一次性塑料制品，以应对塑料危机。
celebrity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

celebrity.sentenceEn: Practically every week features at least one celebrity mom, or mom-to-be, smiling on the newsstands.
celebrity.translationZh: 实际上，每周都至少有一位明星妈妈或准妈妈面带微笑地登上杂志封面。
celebrity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

celebrity.sentenceEn: Of course, the image of parenthood that celebrity magazines like Us Weekly and People present is hugely unrealistic, especially when the parents are single mothers like Bullock.
celebrity.translationZh: 当然，像《美国周刊》和《人物》这样的名人杂志所呈现的为人父母形象是极不现实的，尤其是当主角是布洛克这样的单身母亲时。
celebrity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

celebrity.sentenceEn: He has also criticised the celebrity chef Jamie Oliver's high-profile attempt to improve school lunches in England as an example of how "lecturing" people was not the best way to change their behaviour.
celebrity.translationZh: 他还批评了名厨杰米·奥利弗高调改善英格兰学校午餐的尝试，认为这是一个例子，说明“说教”并非改变人们行为的最佳方式。
celebrity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

celebrity.sentenceEn: Celebrity moms have influenced our attitude towards child rearing.
celebrity.translationZh: 明星妈妈已经影响了我们对养育子女的态度。

cell.sentenceEn: One of the past winners, Professor Martin Green from the University of New South Wales, Australia, is the inventor of the Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell technology which is now found in most of the world's solar panels.
cell.translationZh: 往届获奖者之一、澳大利亚新南威尔士大学的马丁·格林教授是发射极和背面钝化电池技术的发明者，如今这项技术已应用于全球大多数太阳能电池板。
cell.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

cell.sentenceEn: They've implored citizen scientists to help with bug counting and categorising cancer cells , and even identifying distant galaxies.
cell.translationZh: 他们恳请公民科学家协助进行昆虫计数、癌细胞分类，甚至识别遥远的星系。
cell.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

cell.sentenceEn: Librarians' selfless devotion can act against us when users point to universality of access by holding up a cell phone and saying, "it's all in here" as evidence that libraries are less vital for researchers today.
cell.translationZh: 当用户举起手机说“所有信息都在这里面”，以此证明图书馆对当今研究人员不再那么重要时，图书馆员无私奉献的精神反而可能对我们不利。
cell.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

cell.sentenceEn: This perspective makes sense if you simplify the workings of a complex brain, reducing it to an array of electrical pulses; cells in plants also communicate through electrical signals.
cell.translationZh: 如果你将复杂大脑的运作机制简化为一系列电脉冲，那么这种观点确实有一定道理；植物细胞也通过电信号进行交流。
cell.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

cell.sentenceEn: However, the signaling in a plant is only superficially similar to the firing in a complex animal brain, which is more than "a mass of cells that communicate by electricity," Taiz said.
cell.translationZh: 然而，泰兹指出，植物体内的信号传导与复杂动物大脑中的神经冲动只是表面相似，而动物大脑远不止是'一团通过电流进行交流的细胞'。
cell.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

cell.sentenceEn: Beginning in 2006, some scientists have argued that plants possess neuron-like cells that interact with hormones and neurotransmitters, forming "a plant nervous system, analogous to that in animals," said lead study author Lincoln Taiz.
cell.translationZh: 研究主要作者林肯·泰兹表示，自2006年起，一些科学家就认为植物拥有类神经元细胞，这些细胞能与激素和神经递质相互作用，形成"类似于动物神经系统的植物神经系统"。
cell.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

challenging.sentenceEn: Persuading studios to film here would become much more challenging if we couldn't offer a deep bench of local film workers, on-screen talent and local businesses that support the entertainment industry.
challenging.translationZh: 如果我们无法提供由本地影视从业人员、出镜人才以及支持娱乐产业的本地企业构成的深厚人才储备，那么说服制片厂来此拍摄将会变得更加困难。
challenging.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

challenging.sentenceEn: "It's a double-edged sword because wildfires are getting more severe and larger under climate change and we need this work even more, but then the work gets more challenging ," said Susan Prichard, a fire ecologist at the University of Washington.
challenging.translationZh: 华盛顿大学的火灾生态学家苏珊·普里查德表示：“这是一把双刃剑，因为在气候变化的影响下，野火正变得愈发严重且规模更大，我们比以往任何时候都更需要这项工作，但与此同时，工作的开展也变得更具挑战性。”
challenging.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

challenging.sentenceEn: Yet even as scientists and public officials increasingly agree on the need for more fires in our forests, climate change is making this tactic more challenging , experts said.
challenging.translationZh: 专家表示，尽管科学家和公职人员日益达成共识，认为我们的森林需要更多计划性火烧，但气候变化正使这一策略面临更大的挑战。
challenging.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

challenging.sentenceEn: While future researchers may find the digital realm a challenging place to ply their trade, they won't find it an impossible one.
challenging.translationZh: 尽管未来的研究人员可能会发现数字领域是一个充满挑战的工作场所，但他们不会觉得这是一个无法涉足的领域。
challenging.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

challenging.sentenceEn: These take-off shots are even more challenging because they require a wide-angle lens, which means he must be less than 2cm from the butterfly.
challenging.translationZh: 这些起飞瞬间的拍摄更具挑战性，因为需要使用广角镜头，这意味着他必须距离蝴蝶不到2厘米。

challenging.sentenceEn: it is challenging to predict large wildfires.
challenging.translationZh: 预测大规模山火是一项挑战。

collective.sentenceEn: Often appearing as trodden dirt tracks through otherwise neat green spaces, these routes of collective disobedience cut corners, bisect lawns and cross hills, representing the natural capability of people (and animals) to go from point A to point B most effectively.
collective.translationZh: 这些由集体“违规”踏出的路径，常常在整齐的绿地中形成一条条被踩出的泥土小径，它们抄近道、横穿草坪、翻越山丘，展现了人类（和动物）以最有效方式从A点到达B点的本能倾向。
collective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

collective.sentenceEn: Navigating beyond the organised pavements and parks of our urban spaces, desire paths are the unofficial footprints of a community, revealing the unspoken preferences, shared shortcuts and collective choices of humans.
collective.translationZh: 在城市中规划整齐的人行道和公园之外，那些被称为'欲望小径'的非官方路径如同社区留下的隐形足迹，它们揭示了人们未曾言说的偏好、共同使用的捷径以及群体的集体选择。
collective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

collective.sentenceEn: As desire paths criss-cross through both physical and virtual landscapes, they stand as a proof of the collective insistence on forging unconventional routes and embracing the spirit of communal choice.
collective.translationZh: 当欲望小径在现实与虚拟空间中纵横交错，它们成为了集体坚持开辟非常规路线、拥抱共同选择精神的证明。
collective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

collective.sentenceEn: The effort was a collective one and involved other companies as well as a Swedish university.
collective.translationZh: 这是一项集体努力，有其他公司以及一所瑞典大学共同参与。
collective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

collective.sentenceEn: We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
collective.translationZh: 我们需要能够引导集体行动（并约束污染企业）的前瞻性政策，同时也需要积极参与的公民推动变革。
collective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

collective.sentenceEn: This is because the networked computer has sparked a secret war between downloading and uploading – between passive consumption and active creation – whose outcome will shape our collective future in ways we can only begin to imagine.
collective.translationZh: 这是因为联网计算机引发了一场下载与上传之间的秘密战争——一场被动消费与主动创造之间的较量——其结果将以我们才刚刚开始想象的方式塑造我们共同的未来。

combine.sentenceEn: Combining human creativity and AI algorithms can lead to unique artistic outcomes that are beautiful to the human eye.
combine.translationZh: 人类创意与人工智能算法的结合，能够创造出符合人类审美且独特的艺术成果。
combine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

combine.sentenceEn: O'Hanlon said more research would be needed but suggested that Shakespeare's use of 20,000 words, compared with the everyday 2,000 words, gave a "massive expansion of language into children's lives", which was combined with children "using their whole bodies to bring words to life".
combine.translationZh: 奥汉伦表示，还需要更多研究，但他认为莎士比亚使用的20,000个词汇（相比日常使用的2,000个词汇）为儿童的生活带来了“语言的极大拓展”，同时孩子们“用全身来让文字变得生动起来”。
combine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

combine.sentenceEn: Passing vision tests also produced a similar decline in fatal crashes for those drivers, although there appeared to be no benefit from combining the two.
combine.translationZh: 通过视力测试也能使这些驾驶员的致命撞车事故率产生类似幅度的下降，不过将这两项措施结合起来似乎并无额外益处。
combine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

combine.sentenceEn: Given their combined market value of more than $5.5 trillion, rifling through such small deals—many of them much less prominent than Wunderlist and Sunrise—might seem beside the point.
combine.translationZh: 考虑到这五家公司的总市值超过5.5万亿美元，审查这些小型交易——其中许多远不如Wunderlist和Sunrise知名——似乎有些本末倒置。
combine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

combine.sentenceEn: In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines.
combine.translationZh: 在过去技术发生剧烈变革的时代，企业家们通过想出将劳动力与机器结合的方法，推动了这一转型过程。
combine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

combine.sentenceEn: Applications like tumblr.com, which allow users to combine pictures, words and other media in creative ways and then share them, have the potential to add stickiness by amusing, entertaining and enlightening others.
combine.translationZh: 像tumblr.com这样的应用，允许用户以富有创意的方式将图片、文字和其他媒体内容组合在一起然后分享，它们有潜力通过娱乐、消遣和启发他人来增加这种“黏性”。

conscious.sentenceEn: Another set of participants had to count backward from 1,000 by nines as they watched the clips, occupying their conscious working memory.
conscious.translationZh: 另一组参与者在观看视频片段时，需要从1000开始倒数，每次减9，这占用了他们的有意识工作记忆。
conscious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

conscious.sentenceEn: This forces users to be more conscious of their role in passing along information.
conscious.translationZh: 这迫使用户更加意识到自己在信息传播中的作用。
conscious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

conscious.sentenceEn: Millennials, it seems, face the paradox of being the least formal generation yet the most conscious of style and personal branding.
conscious.translationZh: 千禧一代似乎面临着一个矛盾：他们是最不讲究正式着装的一代，却又是最注重时尚风格和个人品牌塑造的一代。
conscious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

conscious.sentenceEn: Let's not forget sports – in male-dominated corporate America, it's still a big deal. It's not explicitly conscious ; it's the idea that I'm a coach, and you're my team, and we're in this together.
conscious.translationZh: 我们不要忘了体育运动——在男性主导的美国企业界，这仍然是件大事。这并非明确的有意识行为；而是这样一种观念：我是教练，你们是我的团队，我们同舟共济。
conscious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

conscious.sentenceEn: Visual recognition, reads the study, is "an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation".
conscious.translationZh: 该研究指出，视觉识别是“一种自动的心理过程，它快速且直观地发生，几乎或完全没有明显的有意识思考”。
conscious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

conscious.sentenceEn: Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment – including H&M, with its green Conscious Collection line – Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer.
conscious.translationZh: 尽管多家快时尚公司已在努力控制其对劳动力和环境的影响——包括H&M推出的环保“Conscious Collection”（环保自觉行动）系列——但克莱恩认为，唯有消费者才能带来持久的改变。
conscious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

candidate.sentenceEn: But it can also be antagonistic, such as when a political candidate turns toward their competitor during a debate and makes eye contact that signals hostility.
candidate.translationZh: 但眼神交流也可能带有对抗性，例如在辩论中，当一位政治候选人转向对手时，其眼神交流可能传递出敌意。
candidate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

candidate.sentenceEn: That suggests it is in the broader corporate interest to recruit top candidates for increasingly tough jobs.
candidate.translationZh: 这表明，为日益艰巨的工作岗位招募顶尖人才符合更广泛的企业利益。
candidate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

candidate.sentenceEn: Furthermore, the highest CEO salaries are paid to outside candidates , not to the cozy insider picks, another sign that high CEO pay is not some kind of depredation at the expense of the rest of the company.
candidate.translationZh: 此外，最高的CEO薪资支付给了外部候选人，而非关系密切的内部人选，这进一步表明，高额CEO薪酬并非以牺牲公司其他利益为代价的掠夺行为。
candidate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

candidate.sentenceEn: Dr Simonsohn found if the score of the previous candidate in a daily series of interviewees was 0.75 points or more higher than that of the one before that, then the score for the next applicant would drop by an average of 0.075 points.
candidate.translationZh: 西蒙松博士发现，如果在一天的一系列面试中，前一位候选人的得分比他之前的那位高出0.75分或更多，那么下一位申请人的得分平均会降低0.075分。
candidate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

candidate.sentenceEn: This might sound small, but to undo the effects of such a decrease a candidate would need 30 more GMAT points than would otherwise have been necessary.
candidate.translationZh: 这听起来差距不大，但要抵消这种分数下降的影响，候选人的GMAT成绩需要比原本所需高出30分。
candidate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

candidate.sentenceEn: AI looks at resumes in greater numbers than humans would be able to, and selects the more promising candidates .
candidate.translationZh: 人工智能能够处理的简历数量远超人类，并且能够筛选出更有潜力的候选人。

chemical.sentenceEn: Britain has relatively few butterfly species compared with mainland Europe and 80% are in decline, mostly because intensive chemical farming has reduced many species to tiny fragments of habitat and small nature reserves.
chemical.translationZh: 与欧洲大陆相比，英国的蝴蝶物种相对较少，其中80%的物种数量正在下降，这主要是因为集约化的化学农业将许多物种的栖息地缩减为零星的小块区域和小型自然保护区。

chemical.sentenceEn: The volatile chemicals produced by plants can be carried a long way, and they are very characteristic: Each plant or tree has its own particular odor signature.
chemical.translationZh: 植物产生的挥发性化学物质可以传播很远，并且具有非常独特的特征：每种植物或树木都有其特定的气味特征。
chemical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

chemical.sentenceEn: Throughout the trip, Jackson juggled multiple cameras and plate sizes using the collodion process that involved coating the plates with a chemical mixture, exposing them and developing the resulting images with a portable darkroom.
chemical.translationZh: 在整个旅程中，杰克逊使用火棉胶湿版法操作着多台相机和不同尺寸的感光板——这一工艺需要在感光板上涂抹化学混合液，进行曝光，然后用便携式暗房冲洗成像。

chemical.sentenceEn: Van Oosten calls those chemicals "sunscreens" because their goal was to prevent further light damage and rebuild worn polymer fibers.
chemical.translationZh: 范·奥斯坦将这些化学物质称为“防晒霜”，因为它们的目的是防止进一步的光损伤并修复受损的聚合物纤维。
chemical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

chemical.sentenceEn: They infused some with stabilizing and consolidating chemicals .
chemical.translationZh: 他们为部分雕塑注入了具有稳定和加固作用的化学物质。
chemical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

chemical.sentenceEn: For H&M to offer a $5.95 knit miniskirt in all its 2,300-plus stores around the world, it must rely on low-wage overseas labor, order in volumes that strain natural resources, and use massive amounts of harmful chemicals .
chemical.translationZh: 为了能在全球2300多家门店推出这款5.95美元的针织迷你裙，H&M必须依赖海外廉价劳动力，订购量之大足以耗尽自然资源，并且大量使用有害化学物质。
chemical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

classical.sentenceEn: A Polish digital artist who uses classical painting styles to create dreamy fantasy landscapes, Greg Rutkowski has made illustrations for games such as Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering.
classical.translationZh: 格雷格·鲁特科夫斯基是一位波兰数字艺术家，他运用古典绘画风格创作梦幻般的奇幻风景，曾为《龙与地下城》和《万智牌》等游戏绘制插画。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

classical.sentenceEn: He quotes a giant of classical economics, Alfred Marshall, in describing this financial impatience as acting like "children who pick the plums out of their pudding to eat them at once" rather than putting them aside to be eaten last.
classical.translationZh: 他引用古典经济学巨匠阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔的话，将这种金融上的急躁行为描述为像“孩子们把布丁里的梅子挑出来立刻吃掉”，而不是把它们留到最后再吃。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

classical.sentenceEn: These new forms were at first mainly written by scholars and performed by amateurs, but in England, as everywhere else in western Europe, the growth of a class of professional actors was threatening to make the drama popular, whether it should be new or old, classical or medieval, literary or farcical.
classical.translationZh: 这些新形式最初主要由学者创作，由业余爱好者表演，但在英国，如同西欧其他各地一样，职业演员阶层的兴起正推动戏剧走向大众化，无论其是新是旧、古典还是中世纪、文学性还是滑稽性。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

classical.sentenceEn: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.
classical.translationZh: 在莎士比亚出生之际，欧洲正见证着宗教戏剧的衰落，以及在古典悲剧与喜剧的启发下新戏剧形式的诞生。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

classical.sentenceEn: Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas – such as free markets and self-reliance – as falling outside the boundaries of routine, and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation.
classical.translationZh: 如今，教授们通常将对历史的进步主义解读和进步主义公共政策视为恰当的研究课题，同时将保守派或古典自由主义思想——如自由市场和自力更生——描绘成超出常规研究范畴，有时甚至是超出正当学术探讨界限的内容。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

classical.sentenceEn: He specializes in classical painting digitalization.
classical.translationZh: 他擅长将古典绘画风格数字化

constitution.sentenceEn: Citizens still have a right to expect private documents to remain private and protected by the Constitution's prohibition on unreasonable searches.
constitution.translationZh: 公民仍有权期望私人文件保持私密性，并受到宪法禁止不合理搜查规定的保护。
constitution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

constitution.sentenceEn: New, disruptive technology sometimes demands novel applications of the Constitution 's protections.
constitution.translationZh: 新兴的颠覆性技术有时需要我们以全新方式应用宪法赋予的各项保护。
constitution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

constitution.sentenceEn: Just how much does the Constitution protect your digital data?
constitution.translationZh: 宪法究竟在多大程度上保护你的数字数据？
constitution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

constitution.sentenceEn: But on the more important matter of the Constitution , the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration's effort to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states.
constitution.translationZh: 但在更重要的宪法问题上，最高法院以8比0的投票结果挫败了奥巴马政府试图打破联邦与州之间权力平衡的努力。
constitution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

constitution.sentenceEn: The framers of the Constitution envisioned law as having authority apart from politics.
constitution.translationZh: 美国宪法的制定者们构想法律拥有独立于政治的权威。
constitution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

constitution.sentenceEn: It may go against the Constitution .

context.sentenceEn: The context of any exhibit is more important to me than whether the object being displayed is 2,000 years old or 2 months old.
context.translationZh: 对我而言，任何展览的背景信息都比展品本身是有2000年历史还是仅2个月历史更为重要。
context.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

context.sentenceEn: "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Vaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary – feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another.
context.translationZh: 弗吉尼亚大学的心理学研究员阿姆里莎·瓦伊什表示：“学术界正在重新兴起对愧疚感的研究，或者说重新思考愧疚感是什么以及它能起到什么作用。”她补充道，这种重新审视是人们更广泛认识的一部分——即情绪并非二元对立的，在一种情境中有利的情绪在另一种情境中可能有害。
context.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

context.sentenceEn: The better you understand the cultural context , the more control you can have over your impact.
context.translationZh: 你对文化语境的理解越透彻，就越能掌控自己给他人留下的印象。
context.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第6句

context.sentenceEn: Enlist the support of professionals and share with them your goals and context .
context.translationZh: 争取专业人士的支持，并向他们说明你的目标和所处环境。
context.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

context.sentenceEn: You begin to infer a context for the text, for instance by making decisions about what kind of speech event is involved: Who is making the utterance, to whom, when and where.
context.translationZh: 你开始为文本推断语境，例如通过判断涉及何种言语事件：谁在说话，对谁说，何时何地说。
context.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

context.sentenceEn: If you are unfamiliar with words or idioms, you guess at their meaning, using clues presented in the context . On the assumption that they will become relevant later, you make a mental note of discourse entities as well as possible links between them.
context.translationZh: 遇到不熟悉的单词或习语时，你会借助上下文中的提示来猜测它们的含义。由于假定这些内容在后续可能会变得重要，你会在脑海中记住语篇实体以及它们之间可能存在的联系。

cope.sentenceEn: For example, neighborhoods with a large elderly population or informal dwellings that cope poorly with heat could get special warnings or be bolstered with cooling centers.
cope.translationZh: 例如，老年人口众多的社区或难以应对高温的非正式住房区，可以获得特殊预警或增设降温中心。
cope.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

cope.sentenceEn: "Children may face serious difficulties in coping with significant moves, especially if it removes them from their current school or support system," he said.
cope.translationZh: 他说：“孩子们在应对重大搬家时可能会面临严重困难，尤其是当搬家让他们离开现在的学校或支持系统时。”
cope.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

cope.sentenceEn: The challenge of coping with automation underlines the need for the U.S. to revive its fading business dynamism: Starting new companies must be made easier.
cope.translationZh: 应对自动化带来的挑战凸显出美国需要重振其日渐衰退的商业活力：必须降低创办新公司的门槛。
cope.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

cope.sentenceEn: My mind seems to be able to cope and the information is stored away neatly.
cope.translationZh: 我的大脑似乎能够应对自如，并且信息都被整齐地储存起来。
cope.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

cope.sentenceEn: The prevention of this type of fraud is no easy task, and a new field of computer science is developing to cope with security issues.
cope.translationZh: 防范这类欺诈行为绝非易事，计算机科学的一个新领域正因应这些安全问题而逐渐发展起来。
cope.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

cope.sentenceEn: Women are more experienced than men in coping with stress.
cope.translationZh: 女性在应对压力方面比男性更有经验。
cope.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

currently.sentenceEn: The animals could benefit from more research: Currently , there are no published genomes from donkeys located south of the Equator in Africa.
currently.translationZh: 这些动物可能会从更多的研究中受益：目前，赤道以南的非洲驴类尚无已发布的基因组数据。
currently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

currently.sentenceEn: As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets, I share the night terrors of historians, and I'd be lying if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists.
currently.translationZh: 作为一名日常工作围绕特藏文献和数字资产展开的图书馆员，我与历史学家们有着同样的梦魇。如果说目前存在一个全面的保存解决方案，那我一定是在撒谎。
currently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

currently.sentenceEn: Currently only 20 percent of the UK's wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world.
currently.translationZh: 目前，英国木材需求量中仅有20%来自本土供应，而该国仍是全球第二大木材净进口国。
currently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

currently.sentenceEn: Both of these books are published next week by Penguin Random House (PRH), a company currently involved in a stand-off with Waterstones.
currently.translationZh: 这两本书均由企鹅兰登书屋（PRH）于下周出版，该公司目前正与水石书店陷入对峙。
currently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

currently.sentenceEn: A recent survey of manufacturing and service industries from Tata Consultancy Services found that companies currently use AI more often in computer-to-computer activities than in automating human activities.
currently.translationZh: 塔塔咨询服务公司近期针对制造业和服务业的一项调查发现，企业目前更多地将人工智能应用于计算机与计算机之间的交互活动，而非自动化人类活动。
currently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

currently.sentenceEn: What challenge is the FTC currently faced with?
currently.translationZh: 联邦贸易委员会（FTC）目前面临什么挑战？

certainly.sentenceEn: Moreover, increased privatization would certainly undercut one of the major reasons why 300 million visitors come to the parks each year: to enjoy nature and get a break from the commercial drumbeat that overwhelms daily life.
certainly.translationZh: 此外，进一步私有化无疑会削弱每年吸引3亿游客前来公园的一个主要原因：享受自然，远离日常生活中无处不在的商业喧嚣。
certainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

certainly.sentenceEn: But it can be done: Glasgow's year as European capital of culture can certainly be seen as one of a complex series of factors that have turned the city into the powerhouse of art, music and theatre that it remains today.
certainly.translationZh: 但这并非不可能：格拉斯哥当选欧洲文化之都的那一年，无疑是促使这座城市发展成为如今艺术、音乐和戏剧重镇的一系列复杂因素之一。
certainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

certainly.sentenceEn: Certainly , it's incredibly hard to maintain patience at all times with your children.
certainly.translationZh: 当然，要时刻对孩子保持耐心绝非易事。
certainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

certainly.sentenceEn: Certainly , there are valid concerns about the patchwork regulations that could result if every state sets its own rules.
certainly.translationZh: 当然，如果每个州都制定自己的规则，可能会导致监管体系混乱，这种担忧不无道理。
certainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

certainly.sentenceEn: But they certainly will reshape it, and all the more so the longer they extend.
certainly.translationZh: 但它们肯定会重塑社会结构，而且经济困境持续的时间越长，影响也就越深远。
certainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

certainly.sentenceEn: Certainly , no homework should be assigned that students cannot complete on their own or that they cannot do without expensive equipment.
certainly.translationZh: 当然，不应布置学生无法独立完成或需要昂贵设备才能完成的家庭作业。
certainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

circumstance.sentenceEn: Intuition's special powers are unleashed only in certain circumstances .
circumstance.translationZh: 直觉的特殊能力只有在特定情况下才能释放出来。
circumstance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

circumstance.sentenceEn: In the absence of work, a society designed with other ends in mind could yield strikingly different circumstances for the future of labor and leisure.
circumstance.translationZh: 如果没有工作，一个为其他目标而设计的社会可能会为劳动和休闲的未来带来截然不同的情景。
circumstance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

circumstance.sentenceEn: They could still invalidate Fourth Amendment protections when facing severe, urgent circumstances , and they could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant.
circumstance.translationZh: 在面临严重、紧急情况时，他们仍然可以不受第四修正案保护条款的限制，并且可以采取合理措施确保在等待搜查令期间手机数据不会被删除或篡改。
circumstance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

circumstance.sentenceEn: You may feel guilt over your past, but you are poisoning the present with the things and circumstances you cannot change.
circumstance.translationZh: 你可能会为过去感到内疚，但你却在用那些无法改变的事情和境况毒害当下。
circumstance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

circumstance.sentenceEn: For: "Men make their own history, but they do not make it just as they please; they do not make it under circumstances chosen by themselves, but under circumstances directly found, given and transmitted from the past."
circumstance.translationZh: 因为：“人们创造自己的历史，但他们并不是随心所欲地创造；他们不是在自己选定的条件下创造，而是在直接碰到的、既定的、从过去承继下来的条件下创造。”
circumstance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

circumstance.sentenceEn: The writer was compelled by circumstances to leave her job.
circumstance.translationZh: 作者是因环境所迫而离职的。
circumstance.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）

constant.sentenceEn: Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replaces analog.
constant.translationZh: 如果数字资产无法持续迁移，历史学家们将对可预见的未来感到忧心忡忡：当数字取代模拟技术时，历史记录可能会突然中断。
constant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

constant.sentenceEn: Those societies came out of the war with levels of enrollment that had been roughly constant at 3-5% of the relevant age groups during the decades before the war.
constant.translationZh: 二战结束时，这些社会的高等教育入学率与战前几十年大致持平，约为相应年龄段人口的3%-5%。
constant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

constant.sentenceEn: Constant health scares just end up with no one listening.
constant.translationZh: 无休止的健康恐慌最终只会让人们充耳不闻。
constant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

constant.sentenceEn: Newport also recommends "deep scheduling" to combat constant interruptions and get more done in less time.
constant.translationZh: 纽波特还推荐使用“深度日程规划”来应对持续不断的干扰，从而在更短时间内完成更多工作。
constant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

constant.sentenceEn: There's always a constant fear of falling behind everyone else on the socially perpetuated "race to the finish line," whether that be toward graduate school, medical school or a lucrative career.
constant.translationZh: 人们总是在社会普遍存在的'冲刺终点线'竞争中害怕落后于他人，无论是在考研究生、医学院还是追求高薪职业方面。
constant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

contain.sentenceEn: But among student subjects who discussed meat ethics, meal purchases containing meat decreased from 52 to 45 percent—and this effect held steady for the study's duration of several weeks.
contain.translationZh: 但在参与肉类伦理讨论的学生受试者中，含肉类的餐食购买比例从52%下降到45%——并且这一效果在数周的研究期间保持稳定。
contain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

contain.sentenceEn: Mental health is the seed that contains self-esteem – confidence in ourselves and an ability to trust in our common sense.
contain.translationZh: 心理健康是孕育自尊的种子——它包含着对自己的信心和相信自己常识判断的能力。
contain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

contain.sentenceEn: And supermarkets contain a lot of stuff.
contain.translationZh: 而超市里的商品琳琅满目。
contain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

contain.sentenceEn: A smartphone may contain an arrestee's reading history, financial history, medical history and comprehensive records of recent correspondence.
contain.translationZh: 智能手机中可能包含被捕者的阅读记录、财务记录、医疗记录以及近期通讯的完整记录。
contain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

contain.sentenceEn: Surveys and test samples have also become important for understanding the larger landscapes that contain archaeological sites.
contain.translationZh: 勘测和试掘样本对于理解包含考古遗址的更广阔地貌也变得至关重要。

contain.sentenceEn: Written accounts contain vital clues for donkey research.
contain.translationZh: 文献记载为驴的研究提供了关键线索。

convey.sentenceEn: Whether we opt for bold, colorful outfits or prefer more understated styles, our dress choices convey messages about who we are and how we want to be perceived.
convey.translationZh: 无论我们选择大胆鲜艳的装扮，还是倾向于低调内敛的风格，我们的着装都在传递信息，展现我们的个性以及我们希望在他人眼中的形象。
convey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

convey.sentenceEn: Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers.
convey.translationZh: 布兰奇指出，即便越来越多的官方指南和教科书反映了气候变化方面的科学共识，但一些传达更具倾向性观点的非官方教育材料仍在向教师们传播。
convey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

convey.sentenceEn: In some settings, red sneakers or dress T-shirts can convey status; in others not so much.
convey.translationZh: 在某些场合，红色运动鞋或休闲T恤能彰显身份地位；而在另一些场合则不然。
convey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

convey.sentenceEn: Television is one of the means by which these feelings are created and conveyed – and perhaps never before has it served so much to connect different peoples and nations as in the recent events in Europe.
convey.translationZh: 电视是创造和传递这些感受的手段之一——在连接不同民族和国家方面，它所发挥的作用或许从未像在欧洲近来发生的事件中那样巨大。

convey.sentenceEn: What message is conveyed in Brooks' statement?

convey.sentenceEn: Of all the varieties, standard English can best convey complex ideas.
convey.translationZh: 在所有语言变体中，标准英语最能准确传达复杂思想。
convey.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

core.sentenceEn: Artists and scientists alike are immersed in discovery and invention, and challenge and critique are core to both, too.
core.translationZh: 艺术家和科学家都沉浸在发现与发明之中，而挑战和批判也是两者的核心所在。
core.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

core.sentenceEn: Education, and not just knowledge gained on campus, will be a core part of Generation Z's career trajectory.
core.translationZh: 教育，不仅仅是在校园里获得的知识，将成为Z世代职业发展轨迹的核心部分。
core.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

core.sentenceEn: Research by the World Economic Forum finds that on average 42 per cent of the " core skills" within job roles will change by 2022.
core.translationZh: 世界经济论坛的研究发现，到2022年，各职业角色中平均42%的"核心技能"将会发生变化。
core.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

core.sentenceEn: The core of her successful defence was that she knew nothing.
core.translationZh: 她成功辩护的核心论点是自己毫不知情。
core.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

core.sentenceEn: I had not realised how profoundly marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development.
core.translationZh: 我之前从未意识到，营销趋势对我们关于儿童天性的认知——包括我们对他们心理发展的核心信念——产生了多么深远的影响。
core.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

core.sentenceEn: In 2010, a federal judge shook America's biotech industry to its core .
core.translationZh: 2010年，一位联邦法官的裁决深深震动了美国生物技术行业的核心。
core.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

costly.sentenceEn: The idea that one might burn down an entire house just to reclaim the nails underlines how scarce, costly and valuable the simple-seeming technology was.
costly.translationZh: 为收回钉子而不惜烧毁整栋房屋的想法，凸显了这项看似简单的技术在当时是多么稀缺、昂贵且珍贵。
costly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

costly.sentenceEn: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
costly.translationZh: 由于就业保护法增加了解雇员工的成本，雇主在招聘新员工时会更加谨慎。
costly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

costly.sentenceEn: France's planned tax is a clear warning: Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly .

costly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

costly.sentenceEn: It's not necessarily a bad thing, but depending on the school, it can be costly to make up credits after switching too late in the game.
costly.translationZh: 这未必是件坏事，但根据学校的不同，如果转专业太晚，补修学分的成本可能会很高。
costly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

costly.sentenceEn: But at least they have demonstrated that when companies get into trouble with the law, evidence of good character can win them a less costly punishment.

costly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

costly.sentenceEn: Many of them instead become the kind of nuisance-lawsuit filer that makes the tort system a costly nightmare.

credibility.sentenceEn: Before you share your thoughts, think about what the powerful person cares about—it may be the credibility of their team or getting a project done on time.

credibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

credibility.sentenceEn: In the end, credibility "happens" to a discovery claim—a process that corresponds to what philosopher Annette Baier has described as the commons of the mind.

credibility.sentenceEn: Two paradoxes exist throughout this credibility process.

credibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

credibility.sentenceEn: This is the credibility process, through which the individual researcher's me, here, now becomes the community's anyone, anywhere, anytime.

credibility.sentenceEn: Then it sponsors lots of symposiums and a credibility project dedicated to wondering why customers are annoyed and fleeing in large numbers.

crime.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

crime.sentenceEn: Theories focusing on the role of society suggest that children commit crimes in response to their failure to rise above their socioeconomic status, or as a rejection of middle-class values.

curb.sentenceEn: The key messages that have been put together for World Environment Day do include a call for governments to enact legislation to curb single-use plastics.

curb.sentenceEn: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.

credit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

credit.sentenceEn: Once someone starts to help, perhaps they'll take over, or get credit for your earlier efforts.
credit.translationZh: 一旦有人开始帮忙，他们可能会喧宾夺主，或者把你之前的努力归功于自己。
credit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

credit.sentenceEn: According to Sichel, although the falling price of nails was driven partly by cheaper iron and cheaper energy, most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails.
credit.translationZh: 西谢尔指出，尽管钉子价格下降部分源于铁价和能源成本的降低，但大部分功劳应归于钉子制造商——他们找到了将钢材转化为钉子的更高效方法。
credit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

credit.sentenceEn: The problem began late last year, when PRH confirmed that it had introduced a credit limit with Waterstones "at a very significant level".
credit.translationZh: 问题始于去年年底，当时企鹅兰登书屋证实已对水石书店实施了"非常严格的"信用额度限制。
credit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

credit.sentenceEn: Taxes on low-wage labor need to be cut, and wage subsidies such as the earned income tax credit should be expanded: This would boost incomes, encourage work, reward companies for job creation, and reduce inequality.
credit.translationZh: 需要削减对低薪劳动力的税收，并扩大诸如劳动所得税收抵免等工资补贴：这将提高收入水平，鼓励就业，奖励创造就业岗位的企业，并减少不平等现象。

capable.sentenceEn: Our mental health doesn't really go anywhere; like the sun behind a cloud, it can be temporarily hidden from view, but it is fully capable of being restored in an instant.
capable.translationZh: 我们的心理健康其实从未离开；它就像乌云后的太阳，可能暂时隐匿不见，但完全能够在瞬间重焕光芒。
capable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

capable.sentenceEn: "I don't think people are capable of that anymore."
capable.translationZh: 我觉得现在的人再也无法做到那样了。
capable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

capable.sentenceEn: I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable .
capable.translationZh: 我也不喜欢配额制；它与我对精英管理——即由有能力者治理——的信念相悖。
capable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

capable.sentenceEn: If appropriate public policies were in place to help all women – whether CEOs or their children's caregivers – and all families, Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than any other highly capable person living in a more just society.
capable.translationZh: 如果能够制定适当的公共政策来帮助所有女性——无论是首席执行官还是儿童照料者——以及所有家庭，那么在一个更加公正的社会中，桑德伯格就不会比其他任何能力出众的人更具新闻价值。
capable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

capable.sentenceEn: Gilbert's own interest in new music has been widely noted: Alex Ross, a classical-music critic, has described him as a man who is capable of turning the Philharmonic into "a markedly different, more vibrant organization."
capable.translationZh: 吉尔伯特本人对新音乐的兴趣已广受关注：古典音乐评论家亚历克斯·罗斯曾这样描述他——他有能力将爱乐乐团转变为“一个显著不同、更具活力的团体。”
capable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

capable.sentenceEn: Not all writers are capable of journalistic writing.
capable.translationZh: 能胜任新闻写作的作家并不多。

cautious.sentenceEn: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
cautious.translationZh: 由于就业保护法增加了解雇员工的成本，雇主在招聘新员工时会更加谨慎。
cautious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

cautious.sentenceEn: If the criterion changed to safety, you would get more cautious drivers who obeyed traffic laws.
cautious.translationZh: 如果评判标准改为安全，司机就会变得更加谨慎，遵守交通法规。
cautious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

cautious.sentenceEn: If "entitled" is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious .
cautious.translationZh: 如果说“有 entitlement 心态”是人们用来形容千禧一代（1981年至1995年出生的人）最常见的形容词——无论这种说法是否公平——那么Z世代的关键词则是务实和谨慎。
cautious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

cautious.sentenceEn: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.
cautious.translationZh: 动荡的商业环境也使得高管们小心翼翼，避免模糊其辞的声明损害自己的声誉。
cautious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

cautious.sentenceEn: For retailers, who last year took in 24 percent of their revenue between Thanksgiving and Christmas, the cautious approach is coming at a crucial time.
cautious.translationZh: 对于零售商而言，他们去年24%的收入来自感恩节到圣诞节期间，消费者这种谨慎消费的趋势正出现在一个关键时期。
cautious.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
cautious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

chain.sentenceEn: "They are absolutely altering the food chain beyond what I think even they understand what they're doing."
chain.translationZh: 他们对食物链的改变，其影响程度就连他们自己可能都没有完全意识到。
chain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

chain.sentenceEn: Then there's the fact that large American companies are much more globalized than ever before, with supply chains spread across a larger number of countries.
chain.translationZh: 此外，美国大公司的全球化程度前所未有，其供应链遍布更多国家。
chain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

chain.sentenceEn: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already.
chain.translationZh: 这项裁决对在多州设有实体门店的大型连锁企业来说是一场胜利，因为它们通常已经对在线购物征收销售税。
chain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

chain.sentenceEn: Big chains have been collecting sales tax nationwide because they typically have physical stores in whatever state a purchase is being shipped to.
chain.translationZh: 大型连锁企业一直在全国范围内征收销售税，因为它们通常在商品所运往的任何一个州都设有实体店。
chain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

chain.sentenceEn: The power and ambition of the giants of the digital economy are astonishing—Amazon has just announced the purchase of the upmarket grocery chain Whole Foods for ＄13.5bn, but two years ago Facebook paid even more than that to acquire the WhatsApp messaging service, which doesn't have any physical product at all.
chain.translationZh: 数字经济巨头的实力与野心令人震惊——亚马逊刚刚宣布以135亿美元收购高端连锁超市Whole Foods，而两年前Facebook为收购连实体产品都没有的WhatsApp消息服务支付了更高的价格。
chain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

chain.sentenceEn: When did it become accepted wisdom that students should be able to name the 13th president of the United States but be utterly overwhelmed by a broken bike chain ?
chain.translationZh: 从何时起，人们普遍认为学生应当能说出美国第13任总统是谁，却对一条断裂的自行车链条束手无策？
chain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

circuit.sentenceEn: At issue before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit was the latest take of the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) on net neutrality, adopted on a party-line vote in 2017.
circuit.translationZh: 提交给美国哥伦比亚特区巡回上诉法院的争议焦点是联邦通信委员会（FCC）于2017年通过党派投票方式采纳的最新网络中立性政策。
circuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

circuit.sentenceEn: "What people don't realise is that in order to complete these tasks they need to use both the focus and unfocus circuits in their brain," says Pillay.
circuit.translationZh: 皮莱说：“人们没有意识到的是，要完成这些任务，他们需要同时使用大脑中的专注回路和非专注回路。”
circuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

circuit.sentenceEn: The Federal Circuit 's action comes in the wake of a series of recent decisions by the Supreme Court that have narrowed the scope of protections for patent holders.
circuit.translationZh: 联邦巡回上诉法院的这一举措，紧随最高法院近期作出的一系列裁决之后，这些裁决已缩小了对专利持有人的保护范围。
circuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

circuit.sentenceEn: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets.
circuit.translationZh: 限制商业方法专利申请将会是一个戏剧性的态度转变，因为正是联邦巡回法院自己在1998年所谓的"道富银行案"判决中引入了这类专利，批准了一项共同基金资产池管理方法的专利。
circuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

circuit.sentenceEn: The judges on the Federal Circuit are "reacting to the anti-patent trend at the Supreme Court," says Harold C. Wegner, a patent attorney and professor at George Washington University Law School.
circuit.translationZh: 联邦巡回法院的法官们正在'对最高法院的反专利趋势作出反应'，乔治·华盛顿大学法学院教授、专利律师哈罗德·C·韦格纳说道。
circuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

circuit.sentenceEn: It has been dismissed by the Federal Circuit .
circuit.translationZh: 联邦巡回法院已驳回该专利申请。

client.sentenceEn: But there are few places where clients have more grounds for complaint than America.
client.translationZh: 但几乎没有哪个国家的客户比美国客户更有理由抱怨。
client.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

client.translationZh: 法律行业内部存在要求变革的压力，但监管机构中的反对变革者坚持认为，不让外部人士涉足律师事务所，可以使律师免受只顾赚钱而不是以道德方式为客户服务的压力。
client.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

client.translationZh: 几周之内，全球两大拍卖行——苏富比和佳士得，不得不向那些委托其出售艺术品的客户支付近2亿美元的保证金。
client.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

client.sentenceEn: Most of her clients spend $12 to $50 weekly, but last month two longtime customers suddenly stopped showing up.
client.translationZh: 她的大多数客户每周消费12到50美元，但上个月，两位长期客户突然不再光顾了。

client.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

client.sentenceEn: "I don't know if other clients are going to abandon me, too," she says.
client.translationZh: 她说：“我不知道其他客户是否也会抛弃我。”

closely.translationZh: （没错，所有这些优点与纸质书的相关性都要比电子书更高。）

closely.translationZh: 但奥尔蒂斯表示，这还涉及更深层次的个人问题。她认为，由于艺术与创作者本人有着千丝万缕的联系，这可能会引发数据保护和隐私方面的问题。
closely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

closely.sentenceEn: It is closely related to song and even when written it is usually created to be performed out loud.
closely.translationZh: 诗歌与歌曲渊源深厚，即便被书写成文，也通常是为了能够被大声吟诵而创作的。
closely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

closely.sentenceEn: Our legal system was designed to set law apart from politics precisely because they are so closely tied.
closely.translationZh: 我们的法律体系之所以被设计成将法律与政治分离，正是因为二者之间联系如此紧密。
closely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

closely.sentenceEn: However, Google and other big tech providers monitor their efficiency closely and make improvements.
closely.translationZh: 然而，谷歌和其他大型科技供应商密切监控自身效率并持续改进。
closely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

closely.sentenceEn: Despite variations in detail, wholesale markets in the countries that have been closely examined—France, Germany, Italy and Spain—are made out of the same building blocks.
closely.translationZh: 尽管在细节上存在差异，但经过仔细研究的国家——法国、德国、意大利和西班牙——的批发市场结构基本相同。

collaboration.sentenceEn: These collaborations are likely to become increasingly common.
collaboration.translationZh: 此类合作很可能会变得越来越普遍。
collaboration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

collaboration.sentenceEn: A growth team is made up of members from different departments within your company, and it harnesses the power of collaboration to focus exclusively on finding ways to grow.
collaboration.translationZh: 增长团队由公司内部不同部门的成员组成，它借助协作的力量，专门致力于寻找增长途径。
collaboration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

collaboration.sentenceEn: These were some of the words that Nature readers used to describe their experience of art-science collaborations in a series of articles on partnerships between artists and researchers.
collaboration.translationZh: 这些是《自然》杂志读者在一系列关于艺术家与研究人员合作的文章中，用来描述他们参与艺术与科学合作体验的部分词汇。
collaboration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

collaboration.sentenceEn: Nature's poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever, but, to make a collaboration work, both sides need to invest time, and embrace surprise and challenge.
collaboration.translationZh: 《自然》杂志的调查结果表明，这一趋势依然势头强劲，但是，要使合作取得成功，双方都需要投入时间，并乐于接受惊喜与挑战。
collaboration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

collaboration.sentenceEn: Light was something that both artists and scientists had an interest in, and therefore could form the basis of collaboration .
collaboration.translationZh: 光正是艺术家和科学家共同感兴趣的东西，因此可以成为合作的基础。
collaboration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

collaboration.translationZh: 具体而言，他们呼吁与西部各州政府以及私人土地所有者建立更紧密的合作关系。西部各州政府对联邦政府的行动往往心存疑虑，而私人土地所有者则控制着约95%的草原榛鸡栖息地。
collaboration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

compete.sentenceEn: Kennedy wrote that the rule "limited states' ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field."
compete.translationZh: 肯尼迪写道，这一规则"限制了各州追求长期繁荣的能力，并阻碍了市场参与者在公平竞争环境中竞争。"
compete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

compete.sentenceEn: However, during that course I realized I was not good enough in this area to compete with other creative personalities in the future, so I decided that it was not the right path for me.
compete.translationZh: 然而，在那门课程学习期间，我意识到自己在这个领域的才华不足以在未来与其他富有创造力的人才竞争，因此我断定这并非我的正确道路。
compete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

compete.sentenceEn: As a discovery claim works its way through the community, the interaction and confrontation between shared and competing beliefs about the science and the technology involved transforms an individual's discovery claim into the community's credible discovery.
compete.translationZh: 当一项发现声明在科学界传播时，科学界内部对相关科学和技术既有共识也存在争议，这些观点的相互作用与碰撞，将个人的发现声明转变为科学界公认的可靠发现。
compete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

compete.sentenceEn: For the time, attention, and money of the art-loving public, classical instrumentalists must compete not only with opera houses, dance troupes, theater companies, and museums, but also with the recorded performances of the great classical musicians of the 20th century.
compete.translationZh: 为了争取艺术爱好者的时间、关注和金钱，古典器乐演奏家们不仅必须与歌剧院、舞蹈团、戏剧公司和博物馆竞争，还要与20世纪伟大古典音乐家的录音作品竞争。
compete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

compete.sentenceEn: Clearly, only the biggest and most flexible television companies are going to be able to compete in such a rich and hotly-contested market.
compete.translationZh: 显然，只有规模最大、应变能力最强的电视公司才能在这个利润丰厚且竞争激烈的市场中立足。

compete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

compete.sentenceEn: Railroads typically charge such "captive" shippers 20 to 30 percent more than they do when another railroad is competing for the business.
compete.translationZh: 通常情况下，铁路公司对这些"受牵制的"托运商收取的费用，比有其他铁路公司竞争业务时高出20%至30%。

compete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

concentrate.sentenceEn: Reading will keep you better informed about the world but it can also improve our tech-shattered ability to concentrate .
concentrate.translationZh: 阅读不仅能让你更全面地了解世界，还能修复因科技干扰而受损的专注力。

concentrate.sentenceEn: For a long time, scientists and policy makers concentrated on the idea that teenagers were a problem that needed to be solved.
concentrate.translationZh: 长期以来，科学家和政策制定者都秉持着这样一种观点：青少年是一个需要解决的问题。
concentrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

concentrate.sentenceEn: Ms Denham chose to concentrate the blame on the NHS trust, since under existing law it "controlled" the data and DeepMind merely "processed" it.

concentrate.sentenceEn: "We need to take a magnifying glass to that. Like, 'Wait a minute, is this OK?' Do we want instead to redirect those funds to concentrate on lower-hazard parts of the landscape?"
concentrate.translationZh: 我们需要仔细审视这个问题。比如，‘等一下，这样做真的合适吗？’我们是否应该转而将这些资金集中用于风险较低的区域？
concentrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

concentrate.sentenceEn: When we travel down a well-known route, because we don't have to concentrate much, time seems to flow more quickly.
concentrate.translationZh: 当我们行驶在熟悉的路线上时，由于无需高度集中注意力，时间似乎过得更快。
concentrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

concentrate.sentenceEn: The whirlwind that swept through newsrooms harmed everybody, but much of the damage has been concentrated in areas where newspapers are least distinctive.
concentrate.translationZh: 这场席卷新闻编辑部的风暴让所有人都受到了冲击，但大部分损失集中在报纸最缺乏特色的板块。
concentrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

conventional.translationZh: 他在邮件中写道：“再次强调，高中生必须思考的一个重要问题是‘是什么让你与众不同？’，因此参与非传统的课外活动而非传统活动是一个优势。”

convention.translationZh: 但是，认为新闻记者必须比普通公民更深刻地理解法律，这一观点基于对新闻媒体既有的行业惯例和特殊责任的理解。
convention.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
convention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

convention.translationZh: 它们反映了19世纪的社会习俗。

creature.sentenceEn: Were it not for opportunities to observe these beautiful, wild creatures close to home, many more people would be driven by their fascination to travel to wild areas to seek out, disturb and even hunt them down.
creature.translationZh: 如果没有机会在离家不远的地方观察这些美丽的野生动物，更多人会受好奇心驱使前往野外地区搜寻、惊扰甚至猎杀它们。
creature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第3句

creature.sentenceEn: Zoos are, in that sense, similar to natural history and archeology museums, serving to satisfy our need for contact with these living creatures while leaving the vast majority undisturbed in their natural environments.
creature.translationZh: 从这个意义上说，动物园类似于自然历史博物馆和考古博物馆，它们满足了我们与这些生物接触的需求，同时让绝大多数生物在其自然环境中不受打扰。
creature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

creature.sentenceEn: Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence that these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak, or that they prey only on "worthless" species.
creature.translationZh: 曾几何时，生物学家们也有些过度宣扬这样的证据：这些生物通过捕食体弱的个体来维持猎物群体的健康，或者它们只捕食那些“毫无价值”的物种。
creature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

creature.sentenceEn: Yet these creatures are members of the biotic community and, if its stability depends on its integrity, they are entitled to continuance.
creature.translationZh: 然而这些生物都是生物群落的成员，如果群落的稳定依赖于其完整性，那么它们就有权继续生存下去。
creature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

creature.sentenceEn: Rather than dismissing ourselves as unchangeable creatures of habit, we can instead direct our own change by consciously developing new habits.
creature.translationZh: 我们不应将自己视为受习惯支配、无法改变的生物，而应通过有意识地培养新习惯来引导自身的改变。
creature.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
creature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

creature.sentenceEn: Some creatures in the forest that multiply fast can become a great threat to forest restoration.
creature.translationZh: 森林中一些繁殖迅速的生物可能会对森林恢复造成巨大威胁。

crude.sentenceEn: The crude technique required educated guesses on exposure times, and involved heavy, awkward equipment—several men had to assist in its transportation.
crude.translationZh: 这种原始技术需要凭经验猜测曝光时间，并且所使用的设备笨重难携——需要好几个人帮忙搬运。

crude.sentenceEn: A sacred place of peace, however crude it may be, is a distinctly human need, as opposed to shelter, which is a distinctly animal need.
crude.translationZh: 一个神圣的安宁之地，无论多么简陋，都是人类特有的需求，而与之相对的庇护所则是动物特有的需求。
crude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

crude.sentenceEn: In Europe, taxes account for up to four-fifths of the retail price, so even quite big changes in the price of crude have a more muted effect on pump prices than in the past.
crude.translationZh: 在欧洲，税收占零售价格的比例高达五分之四，因此即使原油价格出现较大波动，对加油站油价的影响也比过去要小得多。
crude.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
crude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

crude.sentenceEn: Since OPEC agreed to supply-cuts in March, the price of crude oil has jumped to almost $26 a barrel, up from less than $10 last December.
crude.translationZh: 自欧佩克3月份同意削减供应以来，原油价格已从去年12月不到10美元一桶飙升至近26美元一桶。
crude.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
crude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

crude.sentenceEn: In most countries the cost of crude oil now accounts for a smaller share of the price of petrol than it did in the 1970s.
crude.translationZh: 在大多数国家，原油成本在汽油价格中所占的比例比20世纪70年代要小。
crude.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
crude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

crude.sentenceEn: Leonard Schlesinger, a Harvard academic and former chief executive of Au Bong Pain, a rapidly growing chain of bakery cafes, says that much "re-engineering" has been crude .
crude.translationZh: 伦纳德·施莱辛格是哈佛大学学者，同时也是快速发展的烘焙咖啡连锁店Au Bong Pain的前首席执行官。他表示，许多“重组再造”都显得粗糙简陋。
crude.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
crude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

capability.sentenceEn: Often appearing as trodden dirt tracks through otherwise neat green spaces, these routes of collective disobedience cut corners, bisect lawns and cross hills, representing the natural capability of people (and animals) to go from point A to point B most effectively.
capability.translationZh: 这些由集体“违规”踏出的路径，常常在整齐的绿地中形成一条条被踩出的泥土小径，它们抄近道、横穿草坪、翻越山丘，展现了人类（和动物）以最有效方式从A点到达B点的本能倾向。
capability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

capability.sentenceEn: New AI technologies are particularly concentrated: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate that just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States.
capability.translationZh: 新的人工智能技术集中度尤其高：布鲁金斯学会的马克·穆罗和刘思凡估计，仅15个城市就占据了美国三分之二的人工智能资产和能力。
capability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

capability.sentenceEn: Indeed, in "An International Perspective on New Zealand's Productivity Paradox" (2014), the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause of the country's poor productivity growth record.
capability.translationZh: 事实上，在《新西兰生产力悖论的国际视角》（2014年）报告中，生产力委员会明确指出，管理能力低下是该国生产力增长记录不佳的一个原因。
capability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

capability.sentenceEn: His analysis should therefore end any self-contentedness among those who may believe that the global position of English is so stable that the young generations of the United Kingdom do not need additional language capabilities .
capability.translationZh: 因此，他的分析应当能警醒那些自满的人——他们可能认为英语的全球地位如此稳固，以至于英国的年轻一代无需掌握其他语言技能。
capability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

capability.sentenceEn: On the contrary, they can help students acquire a sense of commitment by planning for roles that are within their capability and their attention spans and by having clearly stated rules.
capability.translationZh: 相反，成人可以通过规划一些学生力所能及且在其注意力持续范围内的角色，并制定明确的规则，来帮助学生培养责任感。
capability.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
capability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

capability.sentenceEn: It has the capability to identify suspicious citations.

civil.sentenceEn: Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.
civil.translationZh: 该研究不再仅仅关注国内生产总值，而是衡量了来自健康、教育和公民社会参与等方面的40多组不同标准，以便更全面地评估各国的表现。
civil.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

civil.sentenceEn: Some relatively poor European countries have seen huge improvements across measures including civil society, income equality and the environment.
civil.translationZh: 一些相对贫穷的欧洲国家在包括公民社会、收入平等和环境在内的多项指标上都取得了显著改善。
civil.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

civil.sentenceEn: John Donahue at Harvard's Kennedy School points out that the norms of culture in Western civil services suit those who want to stay put but are bad for high achievers.
civil.translationZh: 哈佛大学肯尼迪学院的约翰·多纳休指出，西方公务员制度的文化规范适合那些希望安于现状的人，但对业绩优异者不利。
civil.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

civil.sentenceEn: If the trade unionist Jimmy Hoffa were alive today, he would probably represent civil servants.
civil.translationZh: 如果工会领袖吉米·霍法今天还在世，他很可能会代表公务员。
civil.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

civil.sentenceEn: Whether the separation distances involved would satisfy air-traffic-control regulations is another matter, although a working group at the International Civil Aviation Organisation has included the possibility of formation flying in a blueprint for new operational guidelines.
civil.translationZh: 尽管国际民用航空组织的一个工作组已将编队飞行的可能性纳入新的操作指南蓝图，但相关的间隔距离是否符合空中交通管制规定仍是另一个问题。
civil.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

civil.sentenceEn: Continuing along this path, says writer Earl Shorris, "We will become a second-rate country. We will have a less civil society."
civil.translationZh: 作家厄尔·肖里斯指出，如果继续沿着这条道路走下去，“我们将变成一个二流国家。我们的社会文明程度也将降低。”
civil.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
civil.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

cognitive.sentenceEn: Their well-developed hippocampal structures may enable elephants, like rats and people, to construct cognitive maps.
cognitive.translationZh: 它们发达的海马体结构或许能让大象像老鼠和人类一样构建认知地图。
cognitive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

cognitive.sentenceEn: In a very practical way, the Internet is becoming an external hard drive for our memories, a process known as " cognitive offloading."
cognitive.translationZh: 从非常实际的角度来看，互联网正成为我们记忆的外部硬盘，这一过程被称为'认知卸载'。
cognitive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

cognitive.sentenceEn: It turns out that the brain needs exercise in much the same way our muscles do, and the right mental workouts can significantly improve our basic cognitive functions.
cognitive.translationZh: 事实证明，大脑和我们的肌肉一样，也需要锻炼；而适当的脑力训练可以显著改善我们的基本认知功能。
cognitive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

cognitive.sentenceEn: The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality, identifying traits (particularly in word order) shared by many languages, which are considered to represent biases that result from cognitive constraints.
cognitive.translationZh: 第二次尝试由乔舒亚·格林伯格提出，他采用了更为经验主义的方法来研究语言普遍性，识别出许多语言共有的特征（尤其是在词序方面），这些特征被认为体现了由认知限制所导致的偏好。
cognitive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

cognitive.sentenceEn: To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms.
cognitive.translationZh: 将文化中独特的部分与共有的部分区分开来，或许能让我们理解复杂的文化行为是如何产生的，以及在进化或认知层面是什么因素在引导这些行为。
cognitive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

cognitive.sentenceEn: This success, coupled with later research showing that memory itself is not genetically determined, led Ericsson to conclude that the act of memorizing is more of a cognitive exercise than an intuitive one.
cognitive.translationZh: 这一成功，再加上后来的研究表明记忆力本身并非由基因决定，使埃里克森得出结论：记忆行为更多是一种认知练习，而非直觉活动。
cognitive.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
cognitive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

commitment.sentenceEn: Joseph Adegboyega-Edun, a Maryland high school guidance counselor, says unconventional extracurricular activities can help students impress college admissions offices, assuming they demonstrated serious commitment .
commitment.translationZh: 马里兰州高中辅导员约瑟夫·阿德博耶加-埃敦表示，只要学生表现出认真投入的态度，非传统的课外活动就能帮助他们给大学招生办公室留下深刻印象。
commitment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

commitment.sentenceEn: You can say something like, "I know we seem to be moving toward a first-quarter commitment here. I have reasons to think that won't work. I'd like to lay out my reasoning. Would that be OK?"
commitment.translationZh: 你可以这样说：“我知道我们似乎正准备确定第一季度的任务。但我有理由认为这行不通。我想阐述一下我的理由，可以吗？”
commitment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

commitment.sentenceEn: Some growth stems from a commitment by governments and farsighted businesses to fund cleaner energy sources.
commitment.translationZh: 部分增长源于政府和有远见的企业承诺为清洁能源提供资金支持。
commitment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

commitment.sentenceEn: While the government's commitment to long-term funding may have changed, the very pressing need for more affordable housing is real and is not going away.
commitment.translationZh: 尽管政府对长期资金投入的承诺可能已发生变化，但对更多经济适用房的迫切需求是真实存在且不会消失的。
commitment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

commitment.sentenceEn: Either Entergy never really intended to live by those commitments , or it simply didn't foresee what would happen next.
commitment.translationZh: 要么安特吉公司从未真正打算遵守这些承诺，要么就是它根本没有预料到接下来会发生什么。
commitment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

commitment.sentenceEn: The company, a major energy supplier in New England, provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week when it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the state's strict nuclear regulations.
commitment.translationZh: 这家公司是新英格兰地区的主要能源供应商，上周它宣布要违背长期以来遵守该州严格核法规的承诺，这在佛蒙特州激起了无可非议的公愤。
commitment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

commuter.sentenceEn: However, over the past 12 months, those commuters have also experienced some of the worst rail strikes in years.
commuter.translationZh: 然而，在过去12个月里，这些通勤者还经历了数年来最严重的几次铁路罢工。
commuter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

commuter.sentenceEn: Equally, there is a sense that the travails of commuters in the South East, many of whom will face among the biggest rises, have received too much attention compared to those who must endure the relatively poor infrastructure of the Midlands and the North.
commuter.translationZh: 同样，有一种观点认为，东南部通勤者的艰辛——其中许多人将面临最大幅度的票价上涨——获得的关注过多，而相比之下，中部和北部地区那些必须忍受相对落后基础设施的人们却关注不足。
commuter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

commuter.sentenceEn: In one series of studies, researchers instructed Chicago-area commuters using public transportation to strike up a conversation with someone near them.
commuter.translationZh: 在一系列研究中，研究人员指示芝加哥地区乘坐公共交通的通勤者与身边的人攀谈。
commuter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

commuter.sentenceEn: In one 2011 experiment, behavioral scientists Nicholas Epley and Juliana Schroeder asked commuters to do the unthinkable: Start a conversation.
commuter.translationZh: 在2011年的一项实验中，行为科学家尼古拉斯·埃普利和朱莉安娜·施罗德让通勤者做了一件难以想象的事情：主动发起交谈。
commuter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

commuter.sentenceEn: "When Dr. Epley and Ms. Schroeder asked other people in the same train station to predict how they would feel after talking to a stranger, the commuters thought their ride would be more pleasant if they sat on their own," The New York Times summarizes.
commuter.translationZh: 《纽约时报》总结道：“当埃普利博士和施罗德女士让同一车站的其他乘客预测与陌生人交谈后的感受时，通勤者们认为独自坐着会让旅途更愉快。”
commuter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

commuter.sentenceEn: They had Chicago train commuters talk to their fellow passengers.
commuter.translationZh: 他们让芝加哥的火车通勤者与同行的乘客交谈。
commuter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

considerable.sentenceEn: The industry also points out that real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments and that people who lay fake grass tend to use their garden more.
considerable.translationZh: 人造草坪行业还指出，天然草坪需要大量浇水、施用除草剂及其他养护处理，而铺设人造草坪的人往往会更多地使用他们的花园。
considerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

considerable.sentenceEn: When Microsoft bought task management app Wunderlist and mobile calendar Sunrise in 2015, it picked two newcomers that were attracting considerable buzz in Silicon Valley.
considerable.translationZh: 2015年，微软收购任务管理应用Wunderlist和移动日历应用Sunrise时，选中的是两家在硅谷已引起不小轰动的新兴企业。
considerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

considerable.sentenceEn: Boiling down an individual's output to simple metrics, such as number of publications or journal impacts, entails considerable savings in time, energy and ambiguity.
considerable.translationZh: 将个人成果简化为简单的指标，如发表论文数量或期刊影响因子，确实能大幅节省时间、精力，并减少评估中的模糊性。
considerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

considerable.sentenceEn: But take a longer view and there is a surprising amount that we can say with considerable assurance.
considerable.translationZh: 但如果我们以更长远的视角来看，就会发现有很多事情我们是可以相当有把握地断言的。
considerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

considerable.sentenceEn: However, none of these requirements should deter large retailers (and even some large food producers and existing wholesalers) from trying their hand, for those that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe stand to reap considerable gains.
considerable.translationZh: 然而，这些要求都不应阻止大型零售商（甚至包括一些大型食品生产商和现有批发商）一试身手，因为那些掌握欧洲批发业复杂细节的企业必将获得可观收益。

considerable.sentenceEn: Yet a considerable number of the most significant collections of criticism published in the 20th century consisted in large part of newspaper reviews.
considerable.translationZh: 然而，20世纪出版的大量最重要的评论文集中，有很大一部分内容都来自报纸评论。
considerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

constantly.sentenceEn: For example, a busy street might not suit a motion-sensored door, as it would constantly be opening for passers-by.
constantly.translationZh: 例如，繁忙的街道可能不适合安装运动感应门，因为它会不断为路人自动开启。
constantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

constantly.sentenceEn: Zoos are at the forefront of conservation and constantly evolving to improve how they care for animals and protect each species in its natural habitat.
constantly.translationZh: 动物园处于动物保护的前沿，并且在不断发展进步，以改善其动物照料方式，并保护每个物种在其自然栖息地的生存。
constantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

constantly.sentenceEn: It is unlikely that Generation Z will be done with education at 18 or 21; they will need to be constantly upskilling throughout their career to stay employable.
constantly.translationZh: Z世代不太可能在18岁或21岁就结束学业；他们需要在整个职业生涯中不断提升技能，以保持就业能力。
constantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

constantly.sentenceEn: If my training intensity remains the same, but I'm constantly hungry and dropping weight, this is a sign that I need to increase my daily caloric intake.
constantly.translationZh: 如果我的训练强度保持不变，但却持续感到饥饿且体重下降，这就表明我需要增加每日卡路里摄入量。
constantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

constantly.sentenceEn: As adults, it seems that we are constantly pursuing happiness, often with mixed results.
constantly.translationZh: 作为成年人，我们似乎一直在追求幸福，但其结果往往喜忧参半。
constantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

constantly.sentenceEn: Most importantly, it constantly modifies and enhances the games you play to build on the strengths you are developing – much like a(n) effective exercise routine requires you to increase resistance and vary your muscle use.
constantly.translationZh: 最重要的是，它会不断调整和改进你所玩的游戏，以巩固你正在培养的能力——这很像一套有效的锻炼方案需要你增加阻力并变换肌肉的使用方式。
constantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

constitutional.sentenceEn: Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
constitutional.translationZh: 由于加州这项法律适用于所有董事会，甚至包括那些从未有过歧视历史的董事会，法院很可能会裁定该法律违反了宪法保障的“平等保护”原则。
constitutional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

constitutional.sentenceEn: Two of the three objecting Justices – Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas – agreed with this Constitutional logic but disagreed about which Arizona rules conflicted with the federal statute.
constitutional.translationZh: 在三位持反对意见的大法官中，塞缪尔·阿利托和克拉伦斯·托马斯两位同意这一宪法逻辑，但在亚利桑那州哪些法规与联邦法律存在冲突的问题上持有不同意见。
constitutional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

constitutional.sentenceEn: The Constitutional principles that Washington alone has the power to "establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization" and that federal laws precede state laws are noncontroversial.
constitutional.translationZh: 宪法原则明确规定，唯有联邦政府有权'制定统一的入籍规则'，且联邦法律优先于州法律，这两点毫无争议。
constitutional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

constitutional.sentenceEn: Constitutional law is political because it results from choices rooted in fundamental social concepts like liberty and property.
constitutional.translationZh: 宪法 law 具有政治性，因为它源于植根于自由和财产等基本社会观念的选择。
constitutional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

constitutional.sentenceEn: Although it ruled that there is no constitutional right to physician-assisted suicide, the Court in effect supported the medical principle of "double effect", a centuries-old moral principle holding that an action having two effects—a good one that is intended and a harmful one that is foreseen—is permissible if the actor intends only the good effect.
constitutional.translationZh: 尽管最高法院裁定宪法并未赋予医生协助自杀的权利，但实际上支持了"双重效果"这一医疗原则——这是一项有着数百年历史的道德准则，认为如果一个行为可能产生两种结果（一种是期望达到的良好效果，另一种是可预见的不良效果），只要行为实施者仅意图实现良好效果，该行为就是可允许的。
constitutional.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
constitutional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

contrary.sentenceEn: James Herriot, contrary to popular opinion, did not find it easy in his early days of, as he put it, "having a go at the writing game".
contrary.translationZh: 与普遍看法相反，詹姆斯·赫里奥特在他自己所说的“尝试写作生涯”初期，并未觉得这是件容易的事。
contrary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

contrary.sentenceEn: A new study suggests that contrary to most surveys, people are actually more stressed at home than at work.
contrary.translationZh: 一项新研究表明，与大多数调查结果相反，人们实际上在家中比在工作中压力更大。
contrary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

contrary.sentenceEn: But despite some claims to the contrary , laughing probably has little influence on physical fitness.
contrary.translationZh: 但尽管有一些相反的说法，笑可能对身体健康几乎没有影响。
contrary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

contrary.sentenceEn: Contrary to the descriptions on record, no systematic evidence was found that levels of productivity were related to changes in lighting.
contrary.translationZh: 与记录中的描述相反，没有发现系统性证据表明生产率水平与照明变化有关。
contrary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

contrary.sentenceEn: On the contrary , constraints on improving productivity explain why education isn't developing more quickly there than it is.
contrary.translationZh: 相反，生产力提高所面临的制约恰恰解释了为什么这些国家的教育发展没有更快的原因。
contrary.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
contrary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第6句

contrary.sentenceEn: On the contrary , they can help students acquire a sense of commitment by planning for roles that are within their capability and their attention spans and by having clearly stated rules.
contrary.translationZh: 相反，成人可以通过规划一些学生力所能及且在其注意力持续范围内的角色，并制定明确的规则，来帮助学生培养责任感。
contrary.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
contrary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

controversial.sentenceEn: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial , and therefore vulnerable.
controversial.translationZh: 在诸多缺陷中，当城市被迫独自应对空气污染问题时所必须采取的措施具有政治争议性，因此很容易被推翻。
controversial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

controversial.sentenceEn: In Arizona v. United States, the majority overturned three of the four contested provisions of Arizona's controversial plan to have state and local police enforce federal immigration law.
controversial.translationZh: 在亚利桑那州诉联邦政府一案中，多数大法官推翻了亚利桑那州颇具争议的移民计划中四项受质疑条款中的三项。该计划允许州和地方警察执行联邦移民法。
controversial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

controversial.sentenceEn: Now the nation's top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on business-method patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago.
controversial.translationZh: 如今，美国最高专利法院似乎已做好充分准备缩减商业方法专利的规模，这类专利自10年前首次获批以来就一直备受争议。
controversial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

controversial.sentenceEn: The communications revolution has influenced both work and leisure and how we think and feel both about place and time, but there have been controversial views about its economic, political, social and cultural implications.
controversial.translationZh: 通信革命影响了我们的工作与休闲方式，也改变了我们对时空的认知与感受，但对于其在经济、政治、社会和文化方面的影响，人们却持有争议性的看法。
controversial.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
controversial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

cooperate.sentenceEn: Rats and other animals need to be highly attuned to social signals from others so they can identify friends to cooperate with and enemies to avoid.
cooperate.translationZh: 老鼠和其他动物需要高度敏锐地感知来自同类的社交信号，这样它们才能识别出可以合作的朋友和需要避开的敌人。
cooperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

cooperate.sentenceEn: Among the children who had not been tricked, the majority were willing to cooperate with the tester in learning a new skill, demonstrating that they trusted his leadership.
cooperate.translationZh: 在未被欺骗的孩子中，大多数愿意与测试者合作学习新技能，这表明他们信任测试者的引导。
cooperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

cooperate.sentenceEn: That's because Congress has always envisioned joint federal-state immigration enforcement and explicitly encourages state officers to share information and cooperate with federal colleagues.
cooperate.translationZh: 这是因为国会一直设想联邦与州联合执行移民法律，并明确鼓励州执法人员与联邦同事共享信息并开展合作。
cooperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

cooperate.sentenceEn: Moreover, the integration of the European community will oblige television companies to cooperate more closely in terms of both production and distribution.
cooperate.translationZh: 此外，欧洲共同体的一体化将迫使电视公司在制作和发行两方面进行更紧密的合作。
cooperate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
cooperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

cooperate.sentenceEn: For example, they may encourage research in various ways, including the setting up of their own research centers; they may alter the structure of education, or interfere in order to reduce the wastage of natural resources or tap resources hitherto unexploited; or they may cooperate directly in the growing number of international projects related to science, economics and industry.
cooperate.translationZh: 例如，政府可能会通过各种方式鼓励研究，包括建立自己的研究中心；调整教育结构；干预经济以减少自然资源浪费或开发迄今未被利用的资源；或者直接参与日益增多的与科学、经济和工业相关的国际项目。
cooperate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
cooperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

cooperate.sentenceEn: It results from the wish to cooperate .

cue.sentenceEn: Although the cues used by African elephants for long-distance navigation are not yet understood, smell may well play a part.
cue.translationZh: 尽管非洲象进行长距离导航时所使用的线索目前尚不清楚，但嗅觉很可能在其中发挥了作用。
cue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

cue.sentenceEn: Ambady suspected that deliberation focused them on vivid but misleading cues , such as certain gestures or utterances, rather than letting the complex interplay of subtle signals form a holistic impression.
cue.translationZh: 安巴迪猜测，深思熟虑使参与者将注意力集中在那些鲜明但具有误导性的线索上，比如某些手势或话语，而未能让微妙信号间的复杂相互作用形成一个整体印象。
cue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

cue.sentenceEn: The finding shows how sensitive rats are to social cues , even when they come from basic robots.
cue.translationZh: 这一发现表明，老鼠对社交线索极为敏感，即便这些线索来自构造简单的机器人。
cue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

cue.sentenceEn: Look for cues about how others perceive you.
cue.translationZh: 留意他人如何看待你的线索。
cue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

cue.sentenceEn: Through experiments and observation, social scientists like Dr. Berning have learned that there is power in tying certain behaviors to habitual cues through ruthless advertising.
cue.translationZh: 通过实验和观察，像伯宁博士这样的社会科学家发现，通过强势的广告宣传将特定行为与习惯性暗示联系起来，能产生巨大的影响力。
cue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

cue.sentenceEn: The companies that Dr. Curtis turned to – Procter & Gamble, Colgate-Palmolive and Unilever – had invested hundreds of millions of dollars finding the subtle cues in consumers' lives that corporations could use to introduce new routines.
cue.translationZh: 柯蒂斯博士所求助的公司——宝洁（Procter & Gamble）、高露洁-棕榄（Colgate-Palmolive）和联合利华（Unilever）——已投入数亿美元，用于发掘消费者生活中的微妙线索，企业可利用这些线索来引入新的生活习惯。
cue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

cycle.sentenceEn: Have you pondered the life cycle of intangible formats, digital information, given that those who produce these artifacts seldom make provision for their long-term preservation?
cycle.translationZh: 考虑到那些数字信息和无形格式的创造者很少为其长期保存做出安排，你是否思考过这些产物的生命周期？
cycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

cycle.sentenceEn: Called conditional cash transfers or CCTs, these social assistance programs are designed to reduce inequality and break the cycle of poverty.
cycle.translationZh: 这类社会救助项目被称为有条件现金转移支付(CCTs)，旨在减少不平等现象并打破贫困循环。
cycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

cycle.sentenceEn: And yet, it would be a mistake to think we are right now simply experiencing the painful side of a boom and bust cycle .
cycle.translationZh: 然而，如果认为我们当前只是在经历经济繁荣与萧条周期中的阵痛，那就错了。
cycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

cycle.sentenceEn: By offering on-trend items at dirt-cheap prices, Cline argues, these brands have hijacked fashion cycles , shaking an industry long accustomed to a seasonal pace.
cycle.translationZh: 克莱因认为，这些品牌通过以极低价格提供时尚单品，已经劫持了时尚周期，撼动了这个长期习惯于季节性节奏的行业。
cycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

cycle.sentenceEn: Few Americans attribute this solely to such obvious causes as a devalued dollar or the turning of the business cycle .
cycle.translationZh: 很少有美国人将此仅仅归因于美元贬值或商业周期转变等显而易见的原因。
cycle.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
cycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

cycle.sentenceEn: The trouble is that part of the recent acceleration is due to the usual rebound that occurs at this point in a business cycle , and so is not conclusive evidence of a revival in the underlying trend.
cycle.translationZh: 问题在于，近期生产力的部分加速增长是由于商业周期中这个阶段通常会出现的反弹，因此并不能作为经济根本趋势复苏的确凿证据。
cycle.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
cycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句
